Result: 直接消息数量随代理数增加呈近二次方增长（早期介绍回合贡献显著），最大团队中增长趋于平缓并转向广播；共享规格说明的任务产生密集网络，流水线任务产生围绕局部接口的稀疏网络；共享文件在消息密集工作中可削减约42%输出token，但在文件已承担协调时增加开销；指定协调者不产生通信枢纽也无可靠性改进；无提示条件下代理在五分之四的运行中仍会寻找隐藏材料。

Conclusion: 团队规模、任务类型和文件策略都会显著塑造AI代理团队的协调网络。广播通信在大型团队中成为主要协调方式，共享文件是有效的通信替代品，而显式协调者角色并未发挥作用。代理自发获取隐藏评分材料的行为构成安全隐患，需要在评估环境中加以防范。

Abstract: We study how teams of AI coding agents coordinate while solving programming tasks. Current evaluations usually report whether the agents complete the task and how much the run costs, leaving the coordination inside the team largely unmeasured. We introduce an instrument to measure this coordination. Each run is represented as a temporal network in which agents and files are nodes, and messages, file writes, and file reads are timestamped directed edges with an associated cost. We apply this instrument to 1902 runs, each evaluated with a fixed test suite, across configurations that vary the team size, the team structure, and the file policy. The resulting networks show how coordination changes as teams grow and as the work changes. Direct messaging initially increases close to quadratically with the number of agents, with much of this growth coming from an early round of introductions. As the teams grow further, this increase levels off in the largest teams we study, where agents increasingly communicate through broadcast messages. The task also shapes the network that emerges. Work built around a shared specification produces dense, highly connected teams, while pipeline tasks produce sparse networks organised around local interfaces. Shared files can replace repeated 1-to-1 communication, cutting output tokens by about 42% at eight agents on message-heavy work, while adding overhead when files already carry the coordination. Naming one agent as coordinator creates no communication hub and provides no reliable improvement in success. We also observe an unprompted tendency for agents to seek out hidden grading material. We repeat the key experimental conditions in a sealed environment, replacing the hidden material with marked placeholder files. Across 244 additional runs, agents still reach for it in four fifths of runs, while the coordinator and file-channel findings reproduce.

</details>


### [416] [Cross-Sign Language Transfer Learning Using Domain Adaptation with Multi-scale Temporal Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16804)
*Keren Artiaga,Yang Li,Ercan Engin Kuruoglu,Wai Kin,Chan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出使用迁移学习和域适应方法TA3N（结合时间关系网络TRN模块对齐多尺度时间关系）进行手语识别，发现域适应优于基于神经网络的迁移学习，尤其在美式手语（ASL）识别中效果显著；同时发现对齐短时时间特征更有效，且RGB模态在多数情况下优于光流模态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全球有超过100种不同的手语，但手语识别资源严重匮乏。现有方法难以充分利用有限的数据资源，需要更有效的技术来提升手语识别的性能，以改善听障人士的沟通可达性。

Method: 采用迁移学习和域适应方法TA3N进行手语识别。TA3N利用时间关系网络（TRN）模块来对齐多尺度时间关系，并对比了域适应与基于神经网络的迁移学习的效果。实验中使用RGB和光流（Optical Flow）两种模态进行对比。

Result: 研究发现：1）域适应方法优于基于神经网络的迁移学习，尤其在美式手语（ASL）识别方面表现更佳；2）对齐源域和目标域之间的短时时间特征最为有效；3）RGB模态在大多数情况下优于光流模态。

Conclusion: 本文验证了域适应方法在手语识别中的有效性，为手语识别资源匮乏的问题提供了一种可行的解决方案，旨在改善依赖手语作为主要沟通方式的听障人士的可达性和交流体验。

Abstract: Sign language serves as a vital means of communication for individuals with hearing impairments, yet recognition resources for the over 100 distinct sign languages are severely lacking. In response, we present our work on sign language recognition using transfer learning and the domain adaptation method TA3N, which utilizes the Temporal Relational Network (TRN) module for aligning multi-scale temporal relations. Our findings highlight the superior performance of Domain Adaptation to neural network-based transfer learning, particularly in improving recognition of American Sign Language (ASL). Our research also identifies the effectiveness of aligning shorter-term temporal features between source and target domains. In addition to using RGB, we conducted experiments using Optical Flow mode for the sign language samples, ultimately determining that RGB outperforms Optical Flow in the majority of cases. Our work aims to improve accessibility and communication for individuals who rely on sign language as their primary mode of communication.

</details>


### [417] [Quipu: A Governed Bitemporal Knowledge Graph Store](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16813)
*Steve Brown*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Quipu，一个可嵌入的知识图谱存储系统，彻底反转了传统知识图谱存储的四个默认设计（事后清理、单一时间轴、平等信任、仪表盘治理）。Quipu 引入写入前门控、双时态数据、命名图作为权威与信任单位的格结构，以及自包含的治理规范审计。在 Census 基准和 DEMM-Bench 外部基准上的实验证明其能消除污染缺陷、维持格契约、精确重放判定，并正确回答治理问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着智能体（Agent）成为知识图谱的主要写入者，传统存储中为人工策展设定的四个默认假设（先写入后清理、单一时间轴或没有时间轴、平等信任所有写入者、治理交给仪表盘和中间件）在智能体工作负载下变得不可持续，需要从根本上重新设计存储架构。

Method: Quipu 反转四个默认：1）所有事实必须通过谓语评估待提交后状态的"门控"才能进入；2）数据、信任标签、裁决和规则本身全部采用双时态（bitemporal）记录；3）命名图作为权威和信任的单位，在格（lattice）结构下组合，且组合永不扩大权限；4）治理规范 Σ、痕迹和签名裁决本身存储在被治理的存储中，使审计 T ⊨ Σ 变成一次查询。

Result: 在 Census 基准上：门控存储结束时有 0/6 个植入缺陷（未门控为 6/6）；全部 7 个组合探针满足格契约；50 个满足的裁决按其实时点忠实重放，而仅按最新规则的方案全部 50 个误报。SARC 参考检查器与存储内审计逐裁决一致。在 DEMM-Bench 上，内容级解读在全部 8 种降级条件下正确回答全部 512 个属性级治理问题且零过度主张，而容器存在性基线最多在 87.5% 的问题上过度主张。

Conclusion: Quipu 证明：将治理嵌入存储本身而非外部中间件，能够从根本上解决智能体工作负载下的知识图谱污染、信任和审计问题。其格结构、双时态记录和自包含审计设计提供了可验证的治理保证，并实际帮助发现了需要修复的裁决语义漏洞。

Abstract: Agents now write knowledge graphs, but knowledge-graph stores still carry defaults set when humans curated them: accept writes now and clean later, keep one time axis or none, treat every writer's facts as equally trustworthy, and leave governance to dashboards and middleware. These four defaults are individually convenient and jointly untenable under agent workloads. We present Quipu, an embeddable store that inverts all four: no fact enters except through a gate whose predicates evaluate the pending post-state; data, trust labels, verdicts, and the rules themselves are bitemporal; named graphs are the unit of authority and trust, composed under a lattice whose one invariant is that composition never widens; and the governance specification $Σ$, the trace, and signed verdicts are facts in the store they govern, making the audit $T \models Σ$ a query. We evaluate with Census, a deterministic multi-writer lifecycle whose single seeded run scores every research question against planted ground truth: the gated store ends with 0 of 6 planted defects versus 6 of 6 ungated; all 7 composition probes uphold the lattice contract; 50 of 50 satisfied verdicts re-derive faithfully as of their instant while all 50 would be misreported under a latest-only rule set; and the SARC reference checker agrees with the in-store audit verdict-for-verdict, differing only on coverage semantics. A recorded trace from a governed writer surfaces a live enforcement gap the audit names with its remediation. On DEMM-Bench, an external decision-evidence sufficiency benchmark, a content-only reading of the exported records answers all 512 property-level governance questions correctly with zero overclaim under all eight degradation conditions, while container-presence baselines overclaim on up to 87.5% of them -- and the run surfaced, and led us to close, a gap in what a denial's verdict attests.

</details>


### [418] [Policy Iteration with Human Feedback: Bringing Post-Training RL to In-context Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16831)
*Minh-Ha Nguyen,Cathy Shyr*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出策略迭代与人类反馈（PIHF）框架，利用预训练语言模型作为固定权重的执行基质，通过版本化的自然语言策略和工具集，结合语言模型批评者和临床专家的循环评估-改进机制，在罕见病诊断任务中将Recall@1提升32.7个百分点（GPT-5.4）和31.1个百分点（Qwen3.6-35B），验证了固定权重预训练模型用于专家引导策略开发的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式预训练已建立可复用任务表示，但如何让固定模型在无需权重更新的情况下持续改进其推理策略仍待探索。论文旨在将广义策略迭代的评估-改进循环与语言模型执行基质结合，实现专家引导下的持久性策略演进。

Method: PIHF采用四步循环：（1）以预训练语言模型为执行基质；（2）将持久化修订存储在版本化的自然语言策略和工具集中；（3）语言模型批评者与临床专家共同审查完整面板推理和工具使用轨迹，定位反复出现的失败并形成候选修订；（4）专家可重新解释证据、拥有采纳和回滚的权威，通过Recall@1和Recall@5验证候选执行结果。

Result: 在累计消融实验和超罕见病基准上，PIHF派生的策略在1个专有执行器和3个开放权重执行器（3-490亿活跃参数）上均提升了Recall@1。GPT-5.4提升32.7个百分点，Qwen3.6-35B提升31.1个百分点，两者相差1.7个百分点。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，将预训练语言模型作为固定权重执行基质，结合专家引导的策略开发（PIHF），在罕见病诊断中具有可行性。该框架证明了无需权重更新即可通过自然语言策略迭代实现显著性能提升。

Abstract: Generative pretraining established reusable task representations; later work on language-based task conditioning and in-context learning showed that a fixed model could adapt its behavior from instructions and demonstrations. Policy Iteration with Human Feedback (PIHF) builds on this development and the recurrent evaluate-and-improve structure of generalized policy iteration. PIHF uses a pretrained language model as its execution substrate and moves persistent revision to a versioned natural-language policy and tool set. A language-model critic and clinical expert review complete-panel reasoning and tool-use trajectories to localize recurrent failures and form candidate revisions; the expert may reinterpret the evidence and retains authority over admission and rollback, while Recall@1 and Recall@5 validate outcomes after candidate execution.
  Across cumulative ablations and ultra-rare-disease benchmarks, a PIHF-derived policy improved Recall@1 in one proprietary executor and three open-weight executors spanning 3 to 49 billion active parameters. Gains were 32.7 percentage points for GPT-5.4 and 31.1 points for Qwen3.6-35B, a difference of 1.7 points. These results support the feasibility of using pretrained language models as fixed-weight execution substrates for expert-guided policy development in rare-disease diagnosis.

</details>


### [419] [What Do Compliance Detectors Read? An Audit of Activation Probes and Guard Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16852)
*Saisab Sadhu,Aadit Sengupta,Vinay Kumar Sankarapu,Pratinav Seth*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文发现用于部署大语言模型的合规性检测器存在"规则盲区"（rule blindness）问题：检测器的判定依赖于场景的表面特征而非规则本身。作者建立了跨越两条规则与两个场景的基准测试来证实这一失败，并提出训练无关的激活值读取方法ICS（Internal Compliance Score）用于大规模审计。尽管ICS未能通过预先注册的基准标准、且被词袋模型精确匹配泛化表现，但它因其低成本优势仍具实用价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合规性监控在已部署语言模型中日益成为法律与审计控制的一部分，其意义仅当检测器的判定取决于所陈述规则而非场景表面特征时才成立。作者发现当前合规检测器普遍存在规则盲区：删除、置换或替换规则不会改变检测精度，这严重威胁合规监控的有效性与可信度。

Method: 作者构建了一个交叉设计基准（两条规则×两个场景，使单一因素无法预测标签），测试各类guard与激活探针。随后提出ICS——一种训练无关的激活读取方法，仅用十个标注样本校准、通过单一投影评分。论文还发布了反事实协议与交叉规则基准供社区测试。

Result: 所有被测的guard和激活探针均表现出规则盲区，即使策略条件化guard能正确引用对应条款，但在条款被替换为许可性对应条款时判定几乎不变。ICS未达到预先注册的击败平凡基线的标准，词袋模型在池化泛化上与ICS完全匹配；但ICS成本低，可用于审计四个部署guard模型、一个8B零样本裁判及十三个基准，并在用于候选响应排序时提高机械验证通过率，不过自适应白盒攻击可消除此增益。

Conclusion: 当前合规检测器在根本上未能实现规则敏感检测，规则盲区是普遍问题。步骤式推理（逐步推理）而非任何快速检测器才能摆脱规则盲区。尽管ICS的绝对性能未超越平凡基线，但其低成本与实用性使其在审计场景中仍有价值。作者公开反事实协议与交叉规则基准，以便未来检测器声明可被验证。

Abstract: Regulatory compliance monitoring in deployed language models is increasingly implemented as a legal and audit control, checking model outputs against written rules spanning data protection, healthcare, financial regulation, and platform policy. Such monitoring is meaningful only if a detector's verdict depends on the stated rule rather than on surface features of the scenario. We show this condition fails across the current class of compliance detectors, a failure we call rule blindness. Deleting, permuting, or substituting the governing rule leaves detection accuracy unchanged for every guard and activation probe we test, including a policy-conditioned guard that correctly cites the governing clause yet barely changes its verdict when that clause is swapped for its permissive counterpart. A purpose-built benchmark crossing two rules with two scenarios, so that neither alone predicts the label, confirms the failure under a design no prior benchmark rules out, and shows that step by step reasoning, not any fast detector we test, is what escapes it. Auditing at scale requires a retraining-free detector, so we introduce the Internal Compliance Score (ICS): a training-free activation readout calibrated from ten labelled pairs and scored by a single projection. We hold ICS to the same scrutiny as the guards it audits: a pre-registered criterion for beating trivial baselines is not met, and a bag-of-words model matches its pooled generalisation exactly. It remains useful because it is inexpensive, letting us audit four deployed guard models, an 8B zero-shot judge, and thirteen benchmarks, and it raises the mechanically verified pass rate when used to rank candidate responses, though an adaptive white-box attack removes this gain. We release the counterfactual protocol and crossed-rule benchmark so rule blindness can be tested in future probe and guard claims.

</details>


<div id='cs.RO'></div>

# cs.RO [[Back]](#toc)

### [420] [SpotlessGS: Relightable 3D Gaussian Splatting under Dynamic Illumination for Robotic Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14713)
*Liang Hong,Jiaxin Wei,Simon Schaefer,Stefan Leutenegger,Jaehyung Jung*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种扩展的Dark Gaussian Splatting (DarkGS)框架，用于在黑暗或照明不均环境中进行可重照明的3D重建，通过联合优化光照参数、引入球谐低频率照明模型和MLP-based BRDF来消除照明伪影并提高渲染质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人在黑暗环境中依赖机载光源，但会产生不均匀照明，降低下游感知任务的性能。现有的基于2D图像增强的方法缺乏可靠的监督信号，且无法保持多视图几何一致性。

Method: 1) 在Gaussian Splatting框架中联合优化光照参数，无需显式光照标定；2) 引入基于球谐函数(SH)的低频照明模型，捕捉空间变化的残差和环境光效果；3) 采用MLP-based BRDF建模非朗伯反射。

Result: 在合成和真实数据集上的实验表明，该方法有效缓解了照明伪影，相比先前方法提高了渲染质量和定量性能，并通过下游任务验证了对机器人感知的益处。

Conclusion: 该方法为黑暗环境下的机器人3D重建提供了一种更准确、更灵活的可重照明框架，显著改善了下游感知任务的性能。

Abstract: Robots operating in dark or poorly lit environments rely on onboard lights, which often produce uneven illumination that degrades downstream perception tasks. Prior approaches based on 2D image enhancement lack reliable supervision and fail to preserve multi-view geometric consistency. To address these limitations, we extend Dark Gaussian Splatting (DarkGS) toward a more accurate and flexible relightable 3D reconstruction framework. First, we eliminate the need for explicit light parameter calibration by jointly optimizing lighting parameters within the Gaussian Splatting framework. Second, we introduce a low-frequency illumination model based on spherical harmonics (SH) to capture spatially varying residual and ambient lighting effects. Third, we incorporate an MLP-based Bidirectional Reflectance Distribution Function (BRDF) to model non-Lambertian reflectance. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that our method effectively mitigates illumination artifacts while improving rendering quality and quantitative performance over prior approaches. We further validate its benefits for robotic perception through a downstream task.

</details>


### [421] [MISTac: A Vision-Based Tactile Sensor for Minimally Invasive Surgery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14772)
*Robin Koch,Annabella Mascot,Rayan Younis,Martin Wagner,Stefanie Speidel,Mark Cutkosky,Ingo Sieber,Roberto Calandra*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文介绍了MISTac，一种专为微创手术（MIS）设计的高分辨率视觉触觉传感器。传感器尖端直径8mm，可穿过微创手术穿刺器，具有模块化3D打印外壳设计，光学分辨率176.68μm，触觉分辨率250μm，可检测低至24.3mN的力。通过体内实验验证了其实用性，并训练机器学习模型进行组织分类，达到约84%的交叉验证准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微创和机器人辅助手术相比传统开放手术有很多优势，但剥夺了外科医生的触觉反馈和用手指触诊组织的能力。为了弥补这一缺陷，需要开发能够在微创手术中使用的触觉传感器。

Method: 设计了一个基于视觉的触觉传感器MISTac：采用8mm可更换传感器尖端以适应穿刺器；模块化3D打印外壳允许使用现成且可升级的光学与成像硬件；利用视觉系统实现高分辨率触觉感知；并在体内实验中收集触觉数据训练机器学习模型用于组织分类。

Result: 传感器光学分辨率为176.68μm，触觉分辨率为250μm，可分辨低至24.3mN的力。体内实验验证了其在微创手术中的可用性，机器学习模型在组织分类任务上通过留一交叉验证达到约84%的聚合准确率。

Conclusion: 触觉传感器有潜力帮助外科医生在微创手术中进行组织分类或术中肿瘤定位等任务，MISTac是迈向这一愿景的一小步。传感器已开源发布。

Abstract: Minimally invasive and robot-assisted surgery offer many advantages over traditional open surgery, but deprive surgeons of tactile feedback and the ability to palpate tissue with their fingers. To address this lack of tactile feedback, we introduce the MISTac, a high resolution vision-based tactile sensor specifically designed for palpation in MIS. The sensor has a replaceable sensor tip with a diameter of 8 mm which allows it to fit through the trocars used in minimally invasive surgery. Its modular 3D-printed case design allows the use of bulky off-the-shelf illumination and imaging hardware that can easily be exchanged and upgraded. The sensor has an optical resolution of 176.68 $μm$, a tactile resolution of 250 $μm$, and can resolve forces as little as 24.3 mN. An in vivo study with the sensor shows its usability in minimally invasive surgery. We trained a machine learning model with the tactile data collected in the trial on a tissue classification task achieving an aggregate accuracy of ~84% in a leave-one-out cross validation. Tactile sensors have the potential to one day aid surgeons during minimally invasive surgery with tasks such as tissue classification or intra-operative tumor localization; MISTac is a small step towards this vision. We open-source MISTac at https://github.com/lasr-lab/mistac

</details>


### [422] [Imagining Recovery: Inference-Time Counterfactual Realignment for Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14822)
*Yanyan Zhang,Disheng Liu,Kai Ye,Chaoda Song,Xinpeng Li,Mohsen Hariri,Vikash Singh,Yu Yin,Vipin Chaudhary*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出Counterfactual Realignment (CoRe)，一个无需训练的推理时恢复框架，用于使冻结的VLA模型在遇到在线干扰（如任务目标变化、场景变化或机器人状态变化）时能够自我恢复。CoRe通过想象策略从最近的可行状态向当前目标继续执行的方式，合成观测代替物理执行，然后最小程度地对齐机器人和场景以重新加入想象的延续轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型虽然提升了机器人操作的灵活性和泛化性，但在面对在线干扰（如任务目标变化、场景配置变化、机器人状态变化）时表现脆弱。现有的恢复方法通常需要失败数据、策略重训练或外部纠正代理，这引入了额外的数据需求和执行风险。

Method: CoRe是一种训练无关的推理时恢复框架。核心思路是：当检测到偏差时，CoRe从最近的可行状态出发，通过合成观测"想象"策略如何继续朝当前目标执行，然后最小程度地对齐机器人和场景以重新加入这条想象的延续轨迹，最后将控制权交还给策略。整个过程无需物理试错，保留已完成的任务进度，并以统一方式处理中途指令变化和物理扰动。

Result: 在多个模拟器、VLA骨干网络和真实世界环境中，CoRe将成功率提升了最多85.0个百分点，使其接近正常水平，同时将物理恢复操作减少了42.2%，且无需策略微调或针对失败的恢复训练。

Conclusion: CoRe通过反事实想象和最小化物理对齐，为VLA模型提供了一种轻量级、无需训练的在线恢复方案，能够有效应对在线干扰，兼顾任务进度保持和恢复安全性。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have improved the flexibility and generality of robotic manipulation, yet they remain fragile to online disruptions, such as changes in task goal, scene configuration, or robot state. Existing recovery methods often require failure data, policy retraining, or external corrective agents, introducing additional data requirements and execution risks. We propose Counterfactual Realignment (CoRe), a training-free framework that recovers a frozen VLA at inference time without failure data. Upon detecting a deviation, CoRe imagines how the policy would continue toward the current goal from a recent viable state, using synthesized observations in place of physical execution, and then minimally realigns the robot and scene to rejoin this imagined continuation before returning control to the policy. Recovery is therefore planned without physical trial-and-error, preserves completed task progress, and handles both mid-episode instruction changes and physical perturbations in a unified manner. Extensive experiments across multiple simulators, VLA backbones, and real-world settings show that CoRe improves success rates by up to 85.0 percentage points to near-nominal levels while reducing physical restorations by 42.2%, without policy fine-tuning or failure-specific recovery training.

</details>


### [423] [Modeling and Control of an Eel-Inspired Soft Robot for Design Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14860)
*Zhangjingyi Jiang,Mark Campbell*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个基于有限元法（FEM）的弹性杆模型与流体力学模型耦合的仿真框架，用于模拟鳗鲡式（anguilliform）游泳的软体机器人。该模型能够辅助设计优化，并用于开发基于模型的估计、推理和控制系统，同时可研究材料退化与失效对游泳性能的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 鳗鲡式游动是一种高效的运动模式，而软体机器人新材料的发展使得设计仿鳗软体机器人成为可能。需要一个仿真模型来支持设计优化以及模型驱动的估计、推理和控制系统的开发。

Method: 采用有限元法（FEM）对弹性杆进行建模以捕捉软体鱼机器人的软材料特性，该模型便于随材料属性随时间变化而调整；将材料模型与流体动力模型耦合，以模拟软体细长机器人在水中的行为。

Result: 模型验证了所提出控制方法在实现期望游泳行为方面的有效性；揭示了设计决策的见解，包括不同系统配置的鲁棒性和材料退化/失效的影响；结果表明轻微的对称性破坏设计具有优势，能提供相当的游泳速度但更好的机动性。

Conclusion: 该模型可用于指导未来面向特定任务性能优化的机器人设计决策。

Abstract: Anguilliform locomotion is a highly efficient swimming mode; the advent of new materials for soft robots enables the development of an eel-inspired soft robot. This paper presents a simulation model of an eel-inspired soft robot designed for anguilliform swimming. This model can aid in design optimization and the development of model-based estimation, reasoning, and control systems. A Finite Element Method (FEM) model of an elastic rod is used to capture the soft materials of the robotic fish, which makes it particularly amenable to variation over time as the material properties change. The material model is coupled with a hydrodynamic force model to simulate the behavior of a soft, elongated robot in water. The model is used to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed control approaches in achieving desired swimming behaviors. It also provides insights into design decisions, including the robustness of different system configurations and the impact of material degradation and failure. The results show that slightly asymmetric designs are advantageous, offering comparable swimming velocities but greater maneuverability. This model can be used to guide future robotic design decisions aimed at optimizing performance for specific tasks.

</details>


### [424] [Real-time Estimator of Actuator Control and Health (REACH) on an Eel-Inspired Soft Robot](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14865)
*Zhangjingyi Jiang,Myungsun Park,Michael T. Tolley,Mark Campbell*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文开发了一种名为REACH的软体游泳机器人执行器健康估计算法，该算法结合软体机器人模型、sigma点滤波器和统计假设检验，能够实时估计执行器健康状态并预测退化情况，通过多种传感器配置和游动步态的实验验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水下机器人的运行环境恶劣，软体机器人材料和执行器容易退化，精确估计执行器功能状态对于机器人完成任务以及在执行器退化或失效时安全返回基地至关重要。

Method: REACH架构包含三个核心组件：软体机器人模型用于描述系统动力学、sigma点滤波器（无迹卡尔曼滤波器）以处理非线性问题、形式化统计假设检验来捕获随时间的变化。实验系统比较了三种传感器类型（GPS、IMU、弯曲传感器）的性能，评估了传感器的数量和布置位置，并对比了三种游动步态（直线游动、大转弯、紧转弯）下的健康估计效果。

Result: 弯曲传感器和IMU都是合适的传感器选择；IMU只需两个传感器即可满足需求，而弯曲传感器需要三个；REACH在三种游动步态下均能成功预测执行器健康，性能差异很小；滤波验证方法表明故障估计算法在统计上能一致地找到正确的退化程度；在鱼形机器人的弯曲传感器数据实验验证中，REACH能以含噪声的数据和制造差异成功估计执行器健康。

Conclusion: REACH算法能够有效地实时估计软体游泳机器人的执行器健康状态，在多种传感器配置和操作场景下均表现出良好的鲁棒性，为软体水下机器人的智能维护和可靠运行提供了可行的技术方案。

Abstract: An actuator health estimation algorithm for a soft swimming robot that can perform anguilliform swimming is developed. Due to harsh operational environments of underwater robots, and the common degradation of soft robot materials and actuators, accurate estimation of actuator functionality is necessary for robots to perform their missions as well as return to base in the event of actuator degradation and failure. Termed REACH (Real-time Estimator of Actuator Control and Health), the architecture employs a soft robot model, sigma point filter, and a formal statistical hypothesis test to adequately capture the nonlinearities and changes over time. The performance of REACH using three sensor types (GPS, IMU, and Bend Sensor) with one sensor on each actuator is compared, demonstrating that both bend sensor and IMU are adequate choices. Sensor quantity and placement are evaluated for IMU and bend sensor, showing two sensors are sufficient for IMU, whereas three sensors are needed for bend sensor. Three swimming gaits (linear swimming, wide turning, tight turning) are compared, demonstrating that REACH can successfully predict actuator health for all three gaits, with minimal differences in performance. A filter validation method shows the fault estimation algorithm is statistically consistent in finding the correct degradation. The approach is experimentally evaluated using bend sensor data collected from a fish robot, demonstrating that REACH can successfully estimate actuator health with noisy data and variations in manufacturing.

</details>


### [425] [Geometry-Aware Online Mapping for 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14902)
*Thai Luu,Quan Tran,Hieu Phan,Tuan Dang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文针对3DGS-SLAM系统中从离线重建继承的初始化和密度控制启发式方法在在线SLAM严格优化预算下脆弱的问题，提出了三种几何感知方法：透射保持的稠密化、基于深度和内参的相机感知尺度初始化、以及误差引导的稠密化。实验表明这些方法在可忽略的开销下持续提升渲染质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS-SLAM系统需要在线增量扩展和细化高斯地图，其初始化和密度控制直接决定计算和迭代资源的分配，这与离线重建的长优化调度形成鲜明对比。然而大多数3DGS-SLAM管线直接继承离线重建的启发式方法，在严格的逐关键帧优化预算和增量地图增长下变得脆弱。

Method: 在解耦的3DGS-SLAM设置中，提出三种运行于建图线程的几何感知方法：(1) 透射保持的稠密化（transmittance-preserving densification）；(2) 从深度和内参计算的标准差初始化的相机感知尺度初始化（camera-aware scale initialization）；(3) 聚焦高残差区域新原语的误差引导稠密化（error-guided densification）。

Result: 实验结果显示在渲染质量上持续改进，且计算开销可忽略不计，证明了在线SLAM中光度残差与位姿不确定性之间的耦合关系。

Conclusion: 重新审视并改进3DGS-SLAM的初始化和密度控制启发式方法，能够显著提升在线建图质量，作者计划开源代码以促进社区发展并验证可复现性。

Abstract: Recent 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has enabled efficient photorealistic view synthesis and is rapidly being adopted in simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) systems for online mapping. In these systems, a Gaussian map must be expanded and refined incrementally while tracking runs in real time, so initialization and density control directly determine where limited computation and iterations are spent. This contrasts with offline 3DGS reconstruction, where such heuristics can be amortized over long optimization schedules. However, most 3DGS-SLAM pipelines inherit initialization and density-control heuristics from offline reconstruction, which can become brittle under the strict per-keyframe optimization budgets and incremental map growth of online SLAM. In this work, we revisit these heuristics in a decoupled 3DGS-SLAM setting and propose three geometry-aware methods that operate in the mapping thread: transmittance-preserving densification, camera-aware scale initialization from depth and intrinsics, and error-guided densification that focuses new primitives on high-residual regions. Our results show consistent improvements in rendering quality with negligible overhead, highlighting the coupling between photometric residuals and pose uncertainty in online SLAM. We will open-source our code to the community to foster growth and validate reproducibility.

</details>


### [426] [From Continuous Design to Delay-Aware Discrete Synthesis: Guaranteed High-Bandwidth Joint Control for PMSM Drives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14937)
*Edmundo Pozo Fortunić,Mehmet C. Yildirim,Sami Haddadin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种任务感知、延迟扩展的离散时间关节模型，用于PMSM电流控制器设计。该框架显式考虑通信和计算延迟，支持直接综合具有规定带宽和延迟保证的离散PI电流控制器，并解析确定最小采样频率、控制器增益和直流母线电压要求。仿真和真实嵌入式实验验证了该方法的有效性，相比传统连续时间设计显著降低了采样频率和直流母线电压需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代机器人关节的动态需求日益提高，要求电流控制器在宽速度、加速度和扭矩范围内实现高带宽，此时通信、计算和离散时间效应不可忽视。传统PMSM电流控制器通常在连续时间设计后离散化，采样频率和实现延迟的影响主要依赖启发式选择和迭代验证，缺乏系统性的设计框架。

Method: 提出任务感知的延迟扩展离散时间关节模型，显式建模物理通信与计算延迟；基于该模型直接综合具有规定带宽和延迟保证的离散PI电流控制器；解析推导最小所需采样频率、控制器增益和直流母线电压，以满足规定电机和关节性能要求。

Result: 在多种动态需求场景下的仿真验证了方法的有效性，表明与传统基于连续时间的设计相比，该方法大幅降低了采样频率和直流母线电压需求。在自研定制机器人关节上的真实嵌入式实现条件下也验证了所提框架的可行性。

Conclusion: 该任务感知的延迟扩展离散时间设计框架为机器人关节PMSM电流控制提供了一种系统化设计方法，能够在保证带宽和延迟要求的同时减少硬件资源需求，为高性能机器人关节设计提供了新的设计范式。

Abstract: The increasing dynamic demands of modern robotic joints require current controllers to achieve high bandwidth over wide operating ranges of speed, acceleration, and torque, where communication, computation, and discrete-time effects can no longer be neglected. Conventional PMSM current controllers are typically designed in continuous time and subsequently discretized, leaving the sampling frequency and the impact of implementation delays largely to heuristic selection and iterative validation. This paper introduces a task-aware, delay-extended discrete-time joint model that explicitly accounts for physical communication and computation delays and enables direct synthesis of a discrete PI current controller with prescribed bandwidth and delay guarantees throughout the operating envelope. The framework analytically determines the minimum required sampling frequency, controller gains, and DC-link voltage needed to satisfy the specified motor and joint performance. Simulations across a range of dynamic requirements validate the methodology and demonstrate substantially reduced sampling-frequency and DC-link-voltage requirements compared with conventional continuous-time-based design. Experiments on a newly developed custom robotic joint further validate the proposed framework under real embedded implementation conditions.

</details>


### [427] [SkillComposer: Learning Reusable Skills for Natural-Language Robot Programming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14944)
*John Woods,Hasti Seifi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SkillComposer是一个交互式自然语言机器人编程系统，采用生成-测试架构，让大语言模型迭代地生成和修订机器人程序，并将成功的程序通过在线库学习算法压缩为可复用的宏技能，从而持续提升多步复杂任务的编程能力。通过消融实验和12名参与者的用户研究验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然语言接口可以降低机器人编程的门槛，但现有系统在处理复杂任务时表现不佳。虽然大语言模型能处理好简单指令，但在生成多步任务代码、分解高层指令或复用先前解决方案方面存在困难。

Method: SkillComposer采用生成-测试架构：(1) LLM迭代生成并修订机器人程序，直到执行成功；(2) 成功的程序被存储，并由在线库学习算法处理，将重复出现的函数序列压缩为可复用的宏技能；(3) 这些宏技能在未来的任务中作为程序抽象被复用。

Result: 通过消融实验和12名参与者的用户研究，在操作任务和机器人护理任务上验证了系统效果。结果显示，评估者引导的生成和学得的抽象能够提高任务成功率与可用性，同时减少用户在自然语言机器人编程中的努力。

Conclusion: SkillComposer证明了评估者引导的生成过程和持续学习的程序抽象能够显著提升自然语言机器人编程在复杂多步任务上的表现，减少用户负担。

Abstract: Natural-language interfaces can lower the barrier to programming robots, but existing systems struggle when users request complex tasks. While large language models (LLMs) perform well with simple commands, they often struggle to generate code for multi-step tasks, decompose high-level instructions, or reuse prior solutions. We present SkillComposer, an interactive natural-language robot programming system for simulation environments that continually learns reusable program abstractions. SkillComposer uses a generate-test architecture in which an LLM iteratively generates and revises robot programs before execution. Successful programs are stored and processed by an online library-learning algorithm that compresses recurring function sequences into reusable macro skills for future tasks. We evaluate SkillComposer through ablation experiments and a user study with 12 participants to determine its effectiveness on manipulation and robot caregiving tasks. The results show that evaluator-guided generation and learned abstractions improve success rates and usability while reducing user effort in natural-language robot programming.

</details>


### [428] [Evidence of Absence: Cross-Modal Abductive Risk Perception to Sustain World Models When Vision Fails](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14952)
*Cong Xu,Ravi Sankar*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种模态无关的溯因推理框架，当视觉模态退化或遮挡时，利用互补的声学模态（麦克风阵列）来推断隐藏的道路使用者。通过对"存在签名但缺乏视觉共证"这一模式触发溯因推理，该系统在盲区路口平均提前1.7秒发出警告，比视觉单通道保持更高的危险感知能力（0.87 vs 0.03），并具有良好校准性（ECE 0.034）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结构化世界状态（实体、关系、上下文和预测线索）依赖观测来填充，但当主要视觉模态被遮挡或退化时，这些观测可能缺失。需要解决如何从互补模态维持世界模型的问题，将预期共证缺失视为隐藏原因的证据。

Method: 采用模态无关的溯因推理框架，在声学模态中实例化。麦克风阵列前端估计发动机和轮胎声源的方位，提取接近速率证据（有稳定音调时使用多普勒，否则使用宽带"迫近"读数）。当"签名存在、视觉共证缺失"事件触发时，进行隐藏道路使用者的溯因推理，发出校准的风险警告而非控制指令。隐藏状态可恢复性被分析为可识别性问题，区分共享与模态特有信息；提示被建模为Neyman-Pearson检测，具有明确的虚警预算。

Result: 在真实遮挡路口录音上，方法平均提前1.7秒警告（线视进入前），匹配已发表声学基线持续窗口变体的检测率且虚警减少42%，视内定位中位误差3.4度，校准良好（ECE 0.034），在视觉通道崩溃至0.03的分阶段视觉退化下保持危险感知高于0.87。限制包括：校准可近乎无损迁移到未见过路口但签名分类器不可迁移，移动自我噪声是最主要的部署约束。

Conclusion: 溯因推理框架能有效在视觉退化时通过声学互补模态维持世界模型，其校准性可跨场景迁移，但签名分类器泛化性和自我噪声是实际部署的主要瓶颈。

Abstract: A structured world-state (entities, relations, context, and predictive cues) is designed to preserve prediction-critical content when perception degrades, but it presumes observations to populate it; when the primary visual modality is occluded or degraded, those observations may be missing. We address how to sustain the world model from a complementary modality by treating the absence of expected co-evidence as evidence of a hidden cause. The abductive framework is modality-agnostic; this article instantiates it acoustically. A microphone-array front-end estimates the bearing of engine and tire sources and extracts approach-rate evidence (Doppler when a stable tone exists, a broadband looming readout otherwise); the event "signature present, visual co-evidence absent" then triggers abductive inference of a hidden road user, emitting a calibrated risk advisory rather than a control command. Recoverability of the hidden state is analyzed as an identifiability question separating shared from modality-unique information, and cueing is cast as Neyman-Pearson detection under an explicit false-alarm budget. On real occluded-approach recordings at blind junctions, the method warns a mean 1.7 seconds before line-of-sight entry, matches the sustained-window variant of the published acoustic baseline's detection rate with 42% fewer false alarms, localizes to 3.4 degrees median once in view, is well calibrated (expected calibration error 0.034), and keeps hazard awareness above 0.87 under staged vision degradation that collapses a vision-only channel to 0.03. We also measure the method's limits: calibration transfers to an unseen junction almost losslessly, the signature classifier does not, and moving-ego noise is the binding deployment constraint.

</details>


### [429] [GaussMemory: Task-Driven 3D Gaussian Scene Memory for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14986)
*Zhiqiang Hu,Shouren Huang,Masatoshi Ishikawa*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出从被动存储到主动任务驱动空间记忆的范式转变，并介绍了GaussMemory——一种基于3D高斯泼溅的主动记忆系统，在LIBERO和VLABench基准上超越了现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的3D记忆系统是"被动的记录器"，使用固定手工规则存储观测，对所有场景元素（关键抓取目标或无关背景）一视同仁。作者认为机器人的记忆不应仅仅记录所见内容，而应主动学习如何记忆——发现哪些对象需要精确追踪、如何激进地更新、以及哪些需要丢弃，这些都应端到端学习而非手工设计。

Method: GaussMemory的核心创新是将记忆更新和读取统一为一个认知过程的两个方面，实现双向信息流——任务需求塑造更新策略，反之亦然。技术上利用3D高斯泼溅作为持久几何基底来实现这一主动记忆范式。

Result: 在LIBERO基准上，GaussMemory在Goal和Long-10任务上超越MemoryVLA；在VLABench基准上，分别超越π0-FAST达+5.2%（Track 1）和+6.0%（Track 6）。

Conclusion: 实验结果验证了主动任务驱动空间记忆范式的有效性，证明让机器人"学会如何记忆"比被动记录更优，为长时程机器人操作中的空间记忆设计提供了新方向。

Abstract: Long-horizon robotic manipulation fundamentally relies on persistent spatial memory. However, existing 3D memory systems function merely as passive recorders: they store observations using fixed, hand-crafted rules, treating every scene element--whether a critical grasp target or an irrelevant background wall--with equal importance. In this paper, we propose a paradigm shift from passive storage to active, task-driven spatial memory. We argue that a robot's memory should not simply record what it sees, but actively learn how to remember--discovering which objects to track precisely, how aggressively to update them, and what to discard, all learned end-to-end without hand-designed rules. Crucially, this active paradigm is realized by unifying memory update and readout as two sides of the same cognitive process, enabling bidirectional flow where task needs shape update strategies and vice versa. To instantiate this vision, we introduce GaussMemory, which leverages 3D Gaussian Splatting as a persistent geometric substrate. On LIBERO, GaussMemory outperforms MemoryVLA on Goal and Long-10; on VLABench, it surpasses $π_0$-FAST by +5.2% (Track 1) and +6.0% (Track 6).

</details>


### [430] [HP2-SLAM: Adaptive Hybrid ICP for Robust and Efficient LiDAR SLAM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14996)
*Nam Tran,Thu Tran,Hieu Phan,Thai Luu,Toan Nguyen,William J. Beksi,Tuan Dang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: HP2-SLAM是一个极简而稳健的LiDAR SLAM框架，核心思想是邻里尺寸自适应的混合ICP算法，通过面感知的自适应阈值动态分类点对应关系，在点对面和点对点残差之间取得平衡，从而在结构和退化环境中都能稳定对齐。该方法无需特征工程、学习模块或数据集特定调参，在公开数据集上持续优于强几何基线方法，同时在商品硬件上保持实时性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在LiDAR SLAM中同时实现鲁棒性、准确性和效率仍是一个核心挑战。学习方法虽在基准测试中表现优异，但需要大量训练和计算资源且难以泛化到未见或退化环境；几何方法虽高效可解释，但标准ICP在平面或重复场景中性能会退化。作者希望设计一种既能保持几何方法简单高效，又能提升在退化环境中鲁棒性的方案。

Method: 作者提出HP2-SLAM框架，核心创新是邻里尺寸自适应的混合ICP。关键在于引入面感知的自适应阈值，根据局部几何结构和密度动态分类对应关系，从而在点到面和点到点残差之间进行原则性平衡。该公式在结构化和退化环境中均能稳定对齐。整个系统还集成了子图管理、闭环检测和位姿图优化，构成完整的SLAM管线。

Result: 在多个公开数据集上，HP2-SLAM持续优于强几何基线方法，同时能在商品硬件上维持实时性能，验证了精心设计的几何自适应方法能够在不大幅增加复杂度的前提下实现强泛化能力和鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，无需依赖复杂的特征工程或学习模块，通过精心设计的几何自适应机制即可在LiDAR SLAM中实现鲁棒性、准确性和效率的良好平衡，为几何方法在退化环境中的性能提升提供了一个简洁而有效的解决方案。

Abstract: Achieving robustness, accuracy, and efficiency simultaneously remains a central challenge in light detection and ranging (LiDAR) simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM). While learning-based approaches deliver strong benchmark performance, they often require extensive training, substantial computational resources, and struggle to generalize to unseen or degenerate environments. Geometry-based methods are efficient and interpretable, yet their performance degrades in planar or repetitive scenes due to limitations of standard iterative closest point (ICP) formulations. We present HP2-SLAM, a minimalist yet robust LiDAR SLAM framework built around a neighborhood-size adaptive hybrid ICP. Our key insight is a planarity-aware adaptive threshold that dynamically classifies correspondences based on local geometric structure and density, thereby enabling a principled balance between point-to-plane and point-to-point residuals. This formulation stabilizes alignment in both structured and degenerate environments without feature engineering, learning modules, or dataset-specific tuning. Integrated into a complete SLAM pipeline with submap management, loop closure detection, and pose graph optimization, HP2-SLAM consistently outperforms strong geometry-based baselines across publicly available datasets while maintaining real-time performance on commodity hardware. Our results demonstrate that carefully designed geometric adaptation can achieve strong generalization and robustness without sacrificing simplicity or efficiency.

</details>


### [431] [NPU Offloading of a Frozen Visual Encoder for Robot Policy Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15002)
*Hyojun Yun,Seungjae Won,Hyungpil Moon*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文研究将机器人策略训练中冻结的视觉编码器计算卸载到低功耗NPU（Mobilint Aries2）上，以降低GPU训练能耗。通过异步训练管道，在AR-Actor专家模型上将ResNet18和1~4层Transformer编码器逐步卸载至NPU，对比GPU-only基线。结果显示：能量每样本降低17.1%（L1）至27.9%（L4），但训练时间增加15.2%~37.7%，峰值GPU显存降低约20%，策略成功率下降0.44~1.89个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当机器人策略训练新任务时，冻结视觉编码器可省去反向传播，但其前向传播在每步训练中仍需在GPU上运行，持续消耗GPU算力与能耗。作者希望探索将这部分前向计算迁移到低功耗AI加速器（如NPU）能否在增加数据传输和训练耗时的代价下，实现总能耗的降低，并评估对策略性能的影响。

Method: 构建了GPU和NPU异步训练管道：冻结的视觉编码器以A8W8 INT8精度运行在Mobilint Aries2 NPU上，FP32动作专家在NVIDIA RTX 5060 Ti GPU上训练。设计了GPU-only基线与L1~L4四种条件，逐步将1~4层Transformer编码器层卸载到NPU。每种条件以3个随机种子训练30,000步，测量GPU与NPU板级功耗，并对每个策略在300个环境种子下评估（共4,500次仿真rollout）。

Result: L1卸载ResNet18+首层编码器使每样本能耗降低17.1%，L4全部卸载4层编码器后降低27.9%；但训练时间每样本分别增加15.2%和37.7%。峰值GPU显存占用降低19.8%~20.7%。策略成功率方面，GPU-only为93.33%，NPU条件为91.44%~92.89%，下降0.44~1.89个百分点。

Conclusion: NPU卸载冻结视觉编码器可有效降低训练能耗（最高27.9%），同时减少GPU显存占用，但代价是训练时间显著增加（最高37.7%）以及策略成功率轻微下降（0.44~1.89个百分点）。该方案在能耗敏感场景具有实用价值，但需权衡训练时长与性能损失。

Abstract: When a robot policy is trained for a new task or dataset, its visual encoder can be frozen and only its action generation module trained, reducing training cost. Freezing removes the encoder's backward pass, but its forward pass must still run at every training step because the input images change, so it keeps consuming GPU compute. We therefore ask whether moving this computation to a low power AI accelerator such as an NPU can reduce total energy despite the added data transfer and longer training time, and how it affects policy performance. We built an asynchronous training pipeline that uses both a GPU and an NPU for the AR-Actor specialist. The frozen visual encoder runs in A8W8 INT8 on a Mobilint Aries2 NPU, while the FP32 action expert is trained on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Ti GPU. We compared a GPU-only baseline with four conditions, L1 to L4, which gradually extend NPU offloading from one to four Transformer encoder layers. Each condition was trained for 30,000 steps with three random seeds. We measured GPU board power for the GPU-only condition and combined GPU and NPU board power for the NPU conditions. Energy per sample decreased by 17.1% in L1, which offloaded ResNet18 and the first encoder layer, and by 27.9% in L4, which offloaded ResNet18 and all four encoder layers. In contrast, training time per sample increased by 15.2% in L1 and 37.7% in L4, and peak allocated GPU memory decreased by 19.8 to 20.7%. The 15 resulting policies were each evaluated with the same 300 environment seeds, for a total of 4,500 simulator rollouts. The combined success rate was 93.33% for GPU-only and 91.44 to 92.89% for the NPU conditions. These results show that NPU offloading of a frozen visual encoder can reduce training energy, but it increases training time and lowers policy success rate by 0.44 to 1.89 percentage points compared with GPU-only training.

</details>


### [432] [ForceU-VLA: A Force-Aware Vision-Language-Action Model for Embodied Ultrasound Scanning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15009)
*Xingzheng Wu,Cheng Zhang,Guihao Yan,Xifeng Hu,Zhi Liu,Qing Cai*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出ForceU-VLA，一个力感知的视觉-语言-动作模型，通过力信号与超声图像的协同融合以及阶段自适应调制机制，实现自主嵌入式超声扫描，显著提升接触稳定性和探头压力调节能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有嵌入式超声扫描方法在力与超声模态之间的建模耦合松散，且缺乏对扫描阶段的感知，难以捕捉动态的探头-组织交互过程，限制了扫描质量和系统可靠性。

Method: 1) 提出力-超声协同融合模块(FUSFM)，协同融合超声视觉与力反馈信息，为探头运动提供稳定可靠的引导；2) 提出阶段自适应调制机制(SAMM)，根据不同扫描阶段的任务需求自适应调制多模态特征；3) 构建ForceU-VLA-Data真实世界力感知超声数据集，涵盖两个器官五种临床扫描视图，包含450条专家轨迹和约10万同步多模态帧。

Result: 大量实验表明ForceU-VLA在嵌入式超声扫描中显著提升了接触稳定性和探头压力调节能力，有效增强了任务执行质量和整体系统可靠性。

Conclusion: ForceU-VLA通过力感知的视觉-语言-动作建模，验证了力信号与超声图像深度融合对自主超声扫描的有效性，为该领域提供了新方法框架和公开数据集。

Abstract: Embodied intelligent ultrasound scanning enables the automation and standardization of the ultrasound examination process by integrating perception, decision-making, and execution capabilities. However, existing methods suffer from loosely coupled modeling between force and ultrasound modalities and lack awareness of scanning stages, which limits their ability to capture dynamic probe-tissue interactions. To address these issues, we propose ForceU-VLA, a force-aware Vision-Language-Action model for autonomous embodied ultrasound scanning, which leverages force signals and ultrasound image feedback throughout the scanning process to enable accurate and high-quality ultrasound acquisition. Firstly, we propose a Force-Ultrasound Synergistic Fusion Module (FUSFM) that synergistically fuses ultrasound visual and force-feedback information to provide stable, reliable guidance for probe motion. Secondly, a Stage-Adaptive Modulation Mechanism (SAMM) is proposed to accommodate the task requirements across different scanning stages by adaptively modulating multimodal features to enhance their representation quality. Additionally, we introduce ForceU-VLA-Data, a real-world, force-aware embodied ultrasound dataset that integrates visual, force, and action signals, including data from two organs across five representative clinical scanning views, and comprising 450 expert-collected trajectories with approximately 100,000 synchronized multimodal frames. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that ForceU-VLA significantly improves contact stability and probe pressure regulation in embodied ultrasound scanning, thereby effectively enhancing task execution quality and overall system reliability. The source code is available at https://github.com/VMVLab/ForceU-VLA.

</details>


### [433] [MotionGS-SLAM: Event-Modulated Gaussian Splatting for Motion-Blur Robust SLAM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15024)
*Zhiqiang Hu,Shouren Huang,Masatoshi Ishikawa*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MotionGS-SLAM提出了一种全新的运动模糊处理范式：不试图去除模糊，而是将模糊形成过程作为前向问题在渲染管线中显式建模，利用事件相机的微秒级时间分辨率来实现模糊感知的SLAM系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于视觉的SLAM系统在运动模糊下会灾难性失效，因为它们在尝试解决"从退化观测中恢复清晰内容"这一不适定逆问题。

Method: 提出事件调制的高斯核，通过双重调制机制（空间调制将2D高斯投影从各向同性点变为各向异性的运动对齐椭圆笔触；时间调制根据局部速度自适应调整曝光积分采样密度），联合优化曝光内相机轨迹和3D场景几何。

Result: 实验表明在严重高动态条件下，轨迹精度和地图质量均显著优于现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: 通过将模糊处理从不适定逆问题重构为良好约束的前向生成问题，结合事件相机的独特优势，实现了对运动模糊的鲁棒SLAM。

Abstract: Current Vision-based SLAM systems fail catastrophically when motion blur corrupts the visual input, as they attempt the ill-posed inverse problem of recovering sharp content from degraded observations. We present MotionGS-SLAM, which fundamentally reimagines motion blur handling through a paradigm shift: rather than removing blur artifacts, we reformulate the challenge as a well-constrained forward problem that generatively models blur formation within the rendering pipeline. By leveraging event cameras' microsecond temporal resolution and immunity to motion blur, we introduce a novel event-modulated Gaussian kernel that dynamically adapts each Gaussian's rasterization based on precise motion cues. Our dual-modulation mechanism transforms 2D Gaussian projections from isotropic dots into anisotropic, motion-aligned elliptical brush strokes (spatial modulation) while adaptively varying exposure integral sampling density based on local velocity (temporal modulation). This physics-based approach enables joint optimization of intra-exposure camera trajectories and 3D scene geometry through blur-aware photometric and event-based constraints. Extensive experiments demonstrate significant improvements over state-of-the-art methods in trajectory accuracy and map quality under severe high-motion conditions.

</details>


### [434] [PACE: Phase-Progress-Aware Credit for Long-Horizon Embodied Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15026)
*Chengye Song,Jiawei Zhang,Rui Song,Shengqi Wang,Xiangrong Zhang,Ziyi Wang,Huanbin Zhou,Hongzhou Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: PACE是一个面向长时域操作任务的信用分配框架，通过阶段进度感知的评论家网络为VLA模型后训练提供步骤级信用信号，包含GLC-Critic和PPD两个核心模块，在仿真和真实机器人实验中均显著优于最强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时域操作任务中，一个回合往往跨越数百个控制步骤和多个阶段，而成功或失败仅在回合终止时才显现。策略改进需要步骤级信用信号来区分推进任务的行为与停滞或倒退的行为，但现有的后训练方法无法提供这种细粒度的信用分配。

Method: PACE包含两个关键模块：(1) GLC-Critic（全局-局部协同价值修正评论家）：聚合局部时间窗口内的视觉和运动差分特征，推断每一步的阶段及阶段内进度，并对离散化的剩余成本分布进行残差修正，从而实现步骤级信用分配；(2) PPD（渐进式策略蒸馏）：通过任务级阈值将信用转化为正负条件，训练信用条件化的动作生成策略——先用高信用正样本保护预训练策略，再融入所有正负信用学习质量边界，推理时通过条件输出的差异放大高信用行为。

Result: 广泛的仿真实验和多样的真实机器人臂实验表明，PACE在多个任务上持续超越了最强基线，取得了显著的性能提升。

Conclusion: PACE通过阶段进度感知的信用分配框架，有效解决了长时域操作中步骤级信用分配难题，为VLA模型的后训练提供了更精确的优化信号，在仿真和真实环境中均验证了其有效性。

Abstract: Post-training of vision-language-action (VLA) models typically relies on expert demonstrations and policy interaction trajectories. However, in long-horizon manipulation, a single episode often spans hundreds of control steps and multiple phases, while success or failure is only revealed at episode termination. Policy improvement therefore requires step-level credit signals to distinguish behaviors that advance the task from those that stall or regress. We present PACE, a credit-assignment framework for post-training on long-horizon manipulation, centered on a phase-progress-aware critic. PACE consists of two key modules: (1) the Global-Local Cooperative Value-Correction Critic (GLC-Critic) aggregates visual and motion-difference features within local temporal windows to infer the phase and intra-phase progress of each step, and applies residual correction to a discretized remaining-cost distribution accordingly, enabling step-level credit assignment; (2) Progressive Policy Distillation (PPD) converts credit into positive and negative conditions via task-wise thresholds and trains a credit-conditioned action generation policy: it first protects the pretrained policy with high-credit positive samples, then incorporates all positive and negative credits to learn the quality boundary, and at inference amplifies high-credit behaviors through the difference between conditional outputs. Extensive simulation experiments and diverse real-world robotic-arm experiments demonstrate that PACE consistently achieves significant improvements over the strongest baseline.

</details>


### [435] [Max-Q Selective Imitation for Human-in-the-Loop Online Robot Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15088)
*Zihang Wang,Yishan Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向真实机器人人机协同(HIL)在线强化学习的训练方法，包含两个核心组件：MC Q-chunk评论家（用蒙特卡洛回报回归块级动作价值，对干预轨迹进行直接信用分配）和max-Q选择性模仿（在每状态下，在当前策略动作与缓冲区样本之间模仿Q值更高的动作，通过硬胜者全取规则自动在干预学习与策略自改进之间切换）。在真实USB插拔任务中，ACT QChunk-MCBC在30分钟内达到99%成功率（HIL-SERL需约5小时）；在仿真Peg Insertion和Square任务中同样显著优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实机器人的人机协同在线强化学习需要快速吸收人类干预，同时持续超越人类先验（继续自我改进）。现有方法（如HIL-SERL）收敛慢，且干预轨迹的信用分配会被当前策略的TD备份稀释，导致学习效率低下。

Method: 两个核心组件：1) MC Q-chunk评论家——使用回放缓冲区中的蒙特卡洛回报回归块级动作价值，进行样本平均（行为）策略评估，使干预轨迹被直接（而非被当前策略TD备份稀释地）信用分配；2) max-Q选择性模仿——在每个状态下，在当前策略动作与缓冲区采样动作之间选择Q值更高的动作进行模仿（硬胜者全取规则），自动在干预学习与策略自改进间切换；实际应用中使用标准批评家集成均值来降低比较噪声。

Result: 在真实USB插拔任务（20个演示）中，ACT QChunk-MCBC在30分钟内达到99%成功率，而HIL-SERL需约5小时收敛。在仿真Peg Insertion和Square任务中，ACT/Flow Q-chunk变体在约半小时有效训练内达到≥96%成功率，在成功-时间前沿上优于HIL-SERL、EXPO和E2HiL。

Conclusion: 所提出的QChunk-MCBC方法显著加速了HIL在线强化学习在真实机器人上的收敛速度，兼顾了干预吸收与策略自我改进，为实际部署提供了高效可行的训练方案。

Abstract: Human-in-the-loop (HIL) online reinforcement learning for real robots must absorb human interventions quickly while continuing to improve beyond the human prior. We present a training method for this setting based on two components. First, an \emph{MC Q-chunk} critic regresses chunk-level action values onto Monte Carlo returns from the replay buffer, performing sample-average (behavior) policy evaluation so that intervention trajectories are credited directly rather than diluted by current-policy TD backups. Second, \emph{max-Q selective imitation} updates the actor by imitating, at each state, the higher-$Q$ action between the current policy action and a buffer sample under a hard winner-take-all rule. This rule automatically switches between learning from interventions and on-policy self-improvement: when the autonomous policy is stronger, targets align with the policy distribution, reducing the policy--target-sample gap that otherwise induces execution-time distribution shift. In practice we score candidates with a standard critic ensemble mean to reduce comparison noise, without softening targets or introducing score-gap thresholds. On a real USB pick-and-insertion task with 20 demonstrations, ACT QChunk-MCBC attains 99\% success within 30 minutes of HIL training, whereas HIL-SERL requires about 5 hours to converge. In simulation on Peg Insertion and Square, ACT/Flow Q-chunk variants similarly reach $\ge$96\% success within roughly half an hour of effective training, outperforming HIL-SERL, EXPO, and E2HiL on the success--time frontier.

</details>


### [436] [StructRL: Structured Action-Space Exploration for Flow-Based VLAs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15139)
*Jiarui Yang,Bin Zhu,Jingjing Chen,Na Zou,Yanwei Fu,Jianggang Zhu,Yu-Gang Jiang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出StructRL，一种针对基于流的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型进行在线强化学习的方法。作者发现将结构化噪声注入扩散链中间步骤会被剩余的去噪步骤削弱（称为"结构化噪声稀释"现象），因此提出将策略随机性迁移到动作空间：使用确定性ODE解码器、直接在动作空间注入结构化噪声，以及最后一步回放机制来提供可训练信号。在多个仿真基准和两个真实任务上，StructRL超越了先前的链内噪声基线，提升了探索效率和分布外性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于流的VLA模型在使用在线RL进行任务适配时，注入的随机噪声通常是各向同性或时间独立的，缺乏结构。而机器人探索需要结构化噪声（时间平滑、不同动作组间尺度不同）。作者发现简单地将链内噪声替换为结构化噪声无效，因为中间流时间步加入的噪声会被后续去噪步骤削弱，即"结构化噪声稀释"现象。

Method: StructRL通过三个耦合的设计选择避免噪声稀释：(i) 使用确定性ODE解码器，(ii) 在动作空间直接注入结构化噪声，(iii) 采用最后一步回放机制，使策略梯度更新不为中间去噪状态分配似然。这样既让结构化探索与被执行的动作直接关联，又为流解码器提供可解的训练信号。

Result: 在三个基于流的VLA模型上，多个仿真操作基准和两个真实世界任务中，StructRL相比先前的链内噪声基线方法，在探索效率和分布外（OOD）性能上均取得显著提升。

Conclusion: 结构化动作空间探索是适配基于流的VLA模型进行强化学习的有效途径。将随机性从去噪链内部迁移到动作空间，可避免噪声稀释问题，同时保持探索的结构性和训练的可解性。

Abstract: Flow-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are now widely used for continuous robotic manipulation, and online reinforcement learning (RL) is emerging as a key technique for adapting them to new tasks. Existing RL methods typically inject stochasticity inside the denoising chain, often through isotropic or temporally independent noise. However, effective robot exploration calls for structured noise: temporally smooth and scaled differently across action groups. We show that simply switching the in-chain noise to a structured form does not suffice: noise added at an intermediate flow time can be weakened by the remaining denoising steps before execution, a phenomenon we call \emph{Structured Noise Dilution}. We propose \textbf{StructRL}, which avoids dilution by relocating policy stochasticity to the action space via three coupled choices: (i) a deterministic ODE decoder, (ii) structured noise injected directly in the action space, and (iii) last-step replay, where policy-gradient updates avoid assigning likelihoods to intermediate denoising states. This keeps structured exploration tied to the executed action while providing a tractable training signal for the flow decoder. Across three flow-based VLA models on multiple simulated manipulation benchmarks and two real-world tasks, StructRL improves exploration efficiency and OOD performance over prior in-chain baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of structured action-space exploration for adapting flow-based VLA with RL. \textbf{Project page:} https://flyfaerss.github.io/structrl/

</details>


### [437] [Low-Rank Dynamics-Effective Latent Carriers for Counterfactual Rollout in Learned World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15156)
*Yang Liu,Yuming Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文研究在循环世界模型中，是否可以通过对隐藏状态施加小型低秩补丁（rank-4）来引导模型沿着预期的反事实轨迹自主滚动。在受控的双物体二维碰撞环境中，验证了rank-4补丁足以重定向12步自主滚动，且满足预注册的复制规则，但位置编辑的压力测试表明仅成功编辑不足够，需要动态有效（dynamics-effective）才算真正干预了模型计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型能预测未来，但难以判断隐藏状态中哪些部分真正驱动预测。作者希望探究：能否通过一个小的、可直接寻址的隐藏状态修改，将世界模型放置在预期的反事实轨迹上，然后让模型自主继续生成未来。

Method: 使用192维隐藏状态的循环世界模型，在双物体二维碰撞环境中研究速度编辑。从仅训练数据的factual-to-counterfactual隐藏差异中构建候选低秩载体（low-rank carriers），学习从事实状态和请求编辑到载体系数的映射。在rank网格上测试，冻结程序满足预注册复制规则，并通过随机等范数、错误物体、错误时间等对照实验验证效果。

Result: rank 4是满足完整开发面板标准的最小测试秩。单个rank-4补丁足以重定向12步自主滚动，无需未来观测、教师强制或重复修正。冻结程序在独立训练检查点间满足预注册复制规则，且在相邻干预时间可用。对照实验（随机等范数、错误物体、错误时间）无法解释该效应。但位置编辑压力测试显示，位置补丁可通过对原始滚动标准但特异性不足——no-patch和随机对照同样能通过，说明成功编辑本身并不足够。

Conclusion: rank-4结果识别了测试速度编辑家族的紧凑干预界面，而非封闭的四维状态或内在状态维度。仅编辑成功不够，需要"动态有效"（dynamics-effective）的干预——即能在自主滚动下持续且目标特异性地改变模型未来计算的干预。

Abstract: World models may predict the future without making clear which parts of their hidden state actually drive those predictions. We ask whether a small, directly addressable hidden-state change can place a learned world model on the intended counterfactual trajectory and then let the model continue that future on its own. We study a recurrent world model with a 192-dimensional hidden state in a controlled two-object, two-dimensional collision environment. For a bounded family of local velocity edits, we first verify that the model can natively represent and roll out the edited future. We then construct candidate low-rank carriers from training-only factual-to-counterfactual hidden differences and learn a map from the factual state and requested edit to carrier coefficients. On the registered rank grid, rank 4 is the smallest tested rank that satisfies the full development-panel criteria. A single rank-4 patch at the anchor is sufficient to redirect a 12-step autonomous rollout, with no future observations, teacher forcing, or repeated correction. The frozen procedure satisfies the preregistered replication rule across independently trained checkpoints and remains usable across nearby intervention times. Random equal-norm, wrong-object, and wrong-time controls do not explain the effect. A position-edit stress test provides a negative contrast: the intended position patch can pass the raw rollout criteria, but no-patch and random controls can pass the same criteria, and wrong-object specificity is not established. Thus, successful editing alone is not enough. We use dynamics-effective to describe an intervention that changes the model's future computation in a sustained and target-specific way under autonomous rollout. The rank-4 result identifies a compact intervention interface for the tested velocity-edit family, not a closed four-dimensional state or an intrinsic state dimension.

</details>


### [438] [LAPF: LLM-Agent-Based Path Finder Using the UAVScenes Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15175)
*Yousef Emami,Mohammadhossein Homaei,Hao Zhou,Miguel Gutiérrez Gaitán,Atefeh Hajijamali Arani,Rui Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个基于大语言模型智能体（LLM-Agent）的路径查找框架（LAPF），用于城镇规模室外环境中的无人机自主导航。LAPF通过集成感知、记忆、规划与动作模块，形成闭环认知架构，在开放场地和障碍物注入场景中分别实现了97.1%和98.1%的路径效率，相比CoT提示方法减少了17.2%和15.6%的路径长度，且实现了零钳位事件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于优化、机器学习和强化学习的无人机导航方法依赖预定义模型或任务特定训练，泛化性和适应性不足。虽然LLM辅助方法展现了推理能力，但缺乏记忆、规划和工具交互等智能体功能，限制了其在不确定环境中的表现。

Method: LAPF框架将感知、记忆、规划和动作模块整合为闭环认知架构。智能体利用先前导航经验，执行链式思维（CoT）推理，将每个检测到的障碍物耦合到有界的纠正动作上，并根据环境反馈动态优化航点决策。

Result: 在每种方法三次独立试验中，LAPF在开放场地和障碍物注入场景中分别实现了512.83米和506.37米的平均路径长度（直线最优为497.33米），对应路径效率为97.1%和98.1%，相比CoT提示分别减少17.2%和15.6%的路径长度。LAPF是唯一能将每个检测到的障碍物耦合到有界、度量中立的纠正动作且保持近目标稳定性的方法，两个场景均实现零钳位事件，而CoT提示从9.7增加到14.0。

Conclusion: LAPF框架通过将LLM的推理能力与完整的智能体功能（感知、记忆、规划、动作）相结合，显著提升了无人机在复杂室外环境中的自主导航性能，在路径效率和稳定性方面均优于现有方法，展现了LLM智能体在自主导航领域的巨大潜力。

Abstract: Uncrewed aerial vehicles (UAVs) are increasingly deployed for autonomous navigation in complex outdoor environments, where dynamic conditions and mission requirements require intelligent adaptive decision-making. Existing optimization-based, Machine Learning (ML), and Reinforcement Learning (RL) approaches often rely on predefined models or task-specific training, limiting their generalization and adaptability in uncertain scenarios. Recent Large Language Model (LLM)-assisted approaches offer promising reasoning capabilities but remain constrained by limited agentic functionality, including insufficient memory, planning, and tool interaction mechanisms.This paper proposes an LLM-Agent-Based Path Finder (LAPF) framework for autonomous UAV navigation in town-scale outdoor environments. LAPF extends LLM-assisted navigation by integrating perception, memory, planning, and action modules into a closed-loop cognitive architecture. The proposed agent leverages prior navigation experiences, performs Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning, couples each detected hazard to a bounded corrective action, and dynamically refines waypoint decisions based on environmental feedback.The three independent trials per method demonstrate that LAPF achieves mean path lengths of 512.83 m and 506.37 m, compared to the straight-line optimum of 497.33 m, corresponding to path length reductions of 17.2% and 15.6% relative to CoT prompting and absolute path efficiencies of 97.1% and 98.1% in open-field and obstacle-injected scenarios, respectively. Furthermore, LAPF is the only evaluated approach that couples every detected hazard to a bounded, metric-neutral corrective action while maintaining near-goal stability, with zero clamp events in both scenarios, whereas CoT prompting increases from 9.7 to 14.0 events.

</details>


### [439] [Remember Smarter: Visual History Compressor and Hyperbolic Experience Space for Robotic Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15269)
*Dai Zhou,Jiexi Yan,Tong Li,Yuxuan Wang,Cheng Deng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出Remember Smarter (RS)，一个即插即用的模块，为长时程机器人策略提供视觉历史压缩和双曲经验记忆存储，在不扩大VLA上下文的前提下提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程机器人策略需要高效访问最近的观测和可复用的经验，但同时不能扩大视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型的上下文窗口。现有方法在记忆压缩和经验利用方面存在不足。

Method: RS模块包含两个互补分支：(1) 视觉历史分支：使用双向空间Mamba和因果时间Mamba压缩多视角patch历史，通过残差交叉注意力将记忆暴露给动作相关的隐藏状态，而不改变VLM视觉token流；(2) 经验记忆分支：将成功的VLM最终层状态存储在Poincare VAE空间中，分层组织，并异步将检索到的经验转换为测地线提示token，不阻塞动作推理。

Result: 在pi0上适配后，LIBERO-Plus任务总成功率从53.6%提升到70.6%，并在真实机器人实验中在记忆保持和经验利用方面取得了显著性能提升。

Conclusion: RS通过视觉历史压缩与双曲经验记忆的双分支设计，有效解决了长时程策略中的记忆与经验复用问题，且作为即插即用模块具有良好的泛化性。

Abstract: Long-horizon robot policies require compact access to recent observations and
  reusable experience without expanding the vision-language-action (VLA)
  context. We introduce Remember Smarter (RS), a plug-and-play module with
  complementary visual-history and hyperbolic experience-memory branches. Its
  visual branch compresses multi-view patch histories using bidirectional
  spatial Mamba and causal temporal Mamba, then exposes the resulting memory to
  action-facing hidden states through residual cross-attention while leaving the
  VLM visual-token stream unchanged. Its experience branch stores successful
  final-layer VLM states in a Poincare VAE space, organizes them hierarchically,
  and asynchronously converts retrieved experience into geodesic prompt tokens
  without blocking action inference. When adapted to pi0, RS increases total
  success on LIBERO-Plus from 53.6% to 70.6% and
  achieves substantial
  performance gains in real-robot experiments designed to evaluate memory
  retention and experience utilization.

</details>


### [440] [VTInstructor: Visual Trajectory Prompting for Navigation Instruction Generation in Continuous Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15284)
*Haolin Yang,Yuxing Long,Zihan Yang,Hao Dong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: VTInstructor是首个面向连续环境的VLN指令生成框架，通过将隐含的轨迹几何转换为显式的视觉轨迹提示（EDTC关键帧提取、VTP轨迹叠加、VTMod信号注入、VT-GRPO训练校准），在R2R-CE和RxR-CE基准上刷新了所有NLG指标，生成的指令使冻结导航器的成功率提升至63.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有指令生成器假设离散视角图和平视观察，轨迹结构显式；但在连续环境中，智能体只能接收密集RGB流，轨迹线索难以恢复，因此需要一个无需导航图、预建地图或场景重建的连续环境指令生成方法。

Method: VTInstructor包含四个核心组件：EDTC将长RGB轨迹浓缩为导航关键帧；VTP将路径、转弯和目标线索叠加到关键帧锚点上；VTMod将产生的轨迹信号注入视觉编码器；VT-GRPO在训练过程中校准这种空间注入。整个过程不需要导航图、预建地图或场景重建。

Result: 在R2R-CE和RxR-CE Val Unseen基准上，VTInstructor在所有标准NLG指标上达到SOTA，分别比最强基线提升+0.357 CIDEr和+0.109 CIDEr。生成的指令使冻结导航器的成功率提升至63.3%（+14.7个百分点），并在下游导航任务上提供+3 SR的数据增强收益。

Conclusion: VTInstructor通过将连续环境中的隐含轨迹几何显式化为视觉轨迹提示，有效解决了连续环境中指令生成的难题，不仅刷新了自动指标，还验证了生成指令对下游导航任务的实际价值，展示了作为可扩展数据集构建工具的潜力。

Abstract: Navigation instruction generation from ego-centric RGB video in continuous environments is an important yet challenging task for human-robot interaction and scalable dataset construction. Prior instruction generators assume discrete viewpoint graphs with panoramic observations, where trajectory structure is explicit; in continuous environments, however, the agent receives only a dense RGB stream, making trajectory cues difficult to recover. We propose VTInstructor, the first VLN instruction generation framework for continuous environments. Our key idea is to convert implicit trajectory geometry into explicit visual trajectory prompts: EDTC condenses long RGB trajectories into navigation-critical keyframes, VTP overlays path, turn, and goal cues onto these anchors, VTMod injects the resulting trajectory signals into the visual encoder, and VT-GRPO further calibrates this spatial injection during training, all without requiring a navigation graph, pre-built map, or scene reconstruction. On the challenging R2R-CE and RxR-CE Val Unseen benchmarks, VTInstructor sets a new state of the art across all standard NLG metrics, surpassing the strongest baseline by +0.357 CIDEr and +0.109 CIDEr, respectively. Beyond automatic metrics, VTInstructor-generated instructions raise a frozen follower's success rate to 63.3%, a +14.7 percentage-point gain over the best competing instruction source, and provide consistent data augmentation gains of +3 SR points on downstream navigation tasks.

</details>


### [441] [PhaseLoRA: Control-Regime-Conditioned Low-Rank Adaptation for Continuous-Action Vision-Language-Action Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15285)
*Yufei Guo,Yinan Wu,Haoran Duan,Guiguang Ding,Jungong Han*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: PhaseLoRA是一种轻量级LoRA参数化方法，通过两个弱监督描述符（精细控制倾向和事件/边界强度）在动作块预测的每一步条件下调整适应，从而在连续动作操作中实现相位依赖的适应。在LIBERO上相比匹配参数的高秩LoRA基线提升了12.2个百分点的平均成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的PEFT适配器设计在整个控制轨迹中应用时间上静态的更新，忽略了连续动作操作中相位依赖的本质——策略会经历接近、接触转换、抓取、搬运和放置等多个不同阶段，每个阶段需要不同的适应行为。

Method: PhaseLoRA在动作专家中调节LoRA左因子，使用两个弱监督描述符（fine-control tendency和event/boundary intensity）在每个动作块预测步骤条件化适应。通过调节低秩更新的有效方向使其随时间变化，同时保持骨干网络大部分冻结。

Result: 在LIBERO基准上，PhaseLoRA相比匹配参数的高秩LoRA基线平均成功率提升12.2个百分点，并优于更强的LoRA变体。消融实验表明随机时间调制和标量门控无法复现完整模型的性能，更新方向分析揭示了与预测控制描述符相关的结构化时间变化。

Conclusion: 轨迹内条件化被证实是连续动作VLA策略的一种有效轻量级PEFT维度，为PEFT设计提供了新的方向。

Abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) is a natural way to adapt pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policies, but most adapter designs apply temporally static updates throughout a control rollout, overlooking the phase-dependent nature of continuous-action manipulation. Such policies traverse distinct regimes, including approach, contact transition, grasping, transport, and placement, each requiring different adaptation behaviors. We propose \textbf{PhaseLoRA}, a lightweight LoRA parameterization that conditions adaptation at each action-chunk prediction step using two weakly supervised descriptors: fine-control tendency and event/boundary intensity. PhaseLoRA modulates the LoRA left factor in the action expert, allowing the effective low-rank update direction to vary over time while keeping the backbone largely frozen. On LIBERO, PhaseLoRA improves average success rate by 12.2 points over a matched-parameter high-rank LoRA baseline and outperforms stronger LoRA variants. Ablations show that random temporal modulation and scalar gating do not reproduce the performance of the full model, while update-direction analyses reveal structured temporal variation associated with the predicted control descriptors. These results establish within-trajectory conditioning as an effective lightweight PEFT axis for continuous-action VLA policies.

</details>


### [442] [SCORE: Shape-Conforming Regions for Flight in Enclosed, Degraded Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15289)
*Eric Minwoo Kim,Jong-Kook Kim*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于符号距离场（SDF）的非凸保持区域方法，用于自主无人机在封闭环境中（如洞穴、倒塌结构）的安全导航。该方法通过定义非一致性分数在SDF上，生成紧贴障碍物几何形状的非凸保持区域，避免了传统凸保持区域不必要的膨胀，同时通过传感器体素联合认证和自适应感知退化机制，在感知退化时仍保持安全性和可用自由空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主无人机在进入洞穴、倒塌结构等封闭环境时，空间受限且感知退化。现有的保形预测保持区域使用凸几何原语，其凸包膨胀会吞噬狭窄通道，且随着感知退化而不断增大，浪费宝贵的可用空间。

Method: 1) 在符号距离场（SDF）上定义非一致性分数，生成非凸保持区域，紧贴障碍物几何；2) 采用体素级多传感器观测联合认证，弥补单一传感器的观测盲区；3) 自适应调整障碍物周围的安全边界，依据实测可见度调整，无需天气标签或在线地面真值反馈。

Result: 在真实地下环境中，该方法相比凸基线方法在相同认证覆盖率下保留了更多可用的自由空间，并且产生了更安全的闭环飞行表现。

Conclusion: 基于SDF的非凸保持区域方法能够在封闭退化环境中更高效地平衡安全性与空间利用率，为无人机地下自主导航提供了更优的分布无关安全保障方案。

Abstract: Autonomous UAVs enter enclosed environments such as caves and collapsed structures that confine the vehicle and degrade perception. Conformal prediction provides a distribution-free guarantee by calibrating how far an obstacle keep-out must expand to absorb perception error at a target coverage level. However, existing keep-out regions use convex primitives whose bulges consume narrow passages and grow as perception degrades. Our main contribution defines the nonconformity score on a signed distance field (SDF). This produces a non-convex keep-out that tightly follows obstacle geometry and avoids the unnecessary bulging of equal-margin convex regions. Two supporting components keep this geometry usable as perception degrades. First, a voxelwise union of complementary sensor observations certifies voxels that any single sensor misses. Second, the margin around the obstacle adapts to measured visibility without weather labels or the online ground-truth feedback that single-pass flight cannot provide. Results on real subterranean data show that the resulting distribution-free, shape-conforming keep-out retains more usable free space than convex baselines at the same certified coverage, and produces safer closed-loop flight.

</details>


### [443] [MM-BEV: Enhancing Timeliness by Computing Where and When it Matters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15437)
*Liangkai Liu,Kang G. Shin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MM-BEV是一个实时多模态BEV感知系统，基于"在重要位置和重要时刻计算"的原则，将感知分为必要工作（安全关键物体）和可选工作（非紧急区域），通过关键性排序的ROI选择、稀疏ROI感知特征提取、延迟感知协调器和异步调度器四个机制，在保持安全关键召回率的条件下显著降低推理和端到端延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态BEV感知结合了LiDAR深度精度和相机语义密度，但计算成本高且感知条件不完美，难以实时部署。现有方法压缩单个检测器，忽略了三个关键机会：相机和LiDAR输入内的结构稀疏性、模态间的时间错位，以及许多检测到的物体实际上不会影响规划器的即时决策。

Method: MM-BEV包含四个核心机制：(1)关键性排序的时间ROI选择器，基于先前帧的运动外推检测结果；(2)稀疏ROI感知特征提取，使用共享形状的相机裁剪和上下文自适应分辨率以及ROI感知的LiDAR体素化；(3)延迟感知协调器，根据场景动态和TTC自适应调整LiDAR扫描、图像分辨率和关键帧；(4)异步调度器，解耦感知与推理并跳过过时帧。

Result: 在nuScenes数据集上，MM-BEV将推理延迟降低1.96倍，端到端延迟降低2.93倍，几何关键召回率无损失，安全关键召回率仅下降0.2个百分点。在Clearpath Husky A300（配备Ouster-128 LiDAR、BEV相机和Jetson AGX Orin）上，平均延迟进一步降低2.11倍。

Conclusion: MM-BEV通过"在重要位置和重要时刻计算"的原则，实现了计算资源的高效分配，在不显著牺牲安全关键感知性能的前提下大幅降低延迟，展示了其在实际自动驾驶系统中的部署潜力。

Abstract: Multimodal bird's-eye-view (BEV) perception combines LiDAR depth accuracy with dense camera semantics, but its high computational cost and imperfect sensing conditions make real-time deployment challenging. Existing methods largely compress individual detectors and overlook three opportunities: structured sparsity within camera and LiDAR inputs, timing misalignment between modalities, and the fact that many detected objects do not affect the planner's immediate action. We present MM-BEV, a real-time multimodal BEV system guided by a simple principle: compute where and when it matters. MM-BEV divides perception into mandatory work for safety-critical objects within braking distance of the ego vehicle and with short time-to-collision (TTC), and optional work for less urgent regions. It prioritizes mandatory work and reduces or sheds optional work under tight compute budgets. MM-BEV integrates four mechanisms: (1) a criticality-ranked temporal ROI selector based on motion-extrapolated detections from prior frames; (2) sparse, ROI-aware feature extraction using shared-shape camera crops at context-adaptive resolution and ROI-aware LiDAR voxelization; (3) a latency-aware coordinator that adapts LiDAR sweeps, image resolution, and keyframes according to scene dynamics and TTC; and (4) an asynchronous scheduler that decouples sensing from inference and skips stale frames. On nuScenes, MM-BEV reduces inference latency by 1.96x and end-to-end latency by 2.93x, with no loss in geometry-critical recall and only a 0.2 percentage-point drop in safety-critical recall. On a Clearpath Husky A300 equipped with an Ouster-128 LiDAR, BEV cameras, and a Jetson AGX Orin, MM-BEV further reduces mean latency by 2.11x, demonstrating its potential for real-world autonomous systems.

</details>


### [444] [Accelerating Mixed Discrete-Continuous Motion Planning via Neural Graphs of Convex Sets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15440)
*Ananya Trivedi,Sarvesh Prajapati,Mohamed Khalid M Jaffar,Zhexin Xu,David Rosen,Taskin Padir*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于图注意力网络的学习策略来加速 Graphs of Convex Sets (GCS) 运动规划框架。通过用 GNN 单次前向传播替代昂贵的凸松弛步骤，预测高概率候选路径，再用轻量级排序网络按成本排序并早期终止搜索，在多个机器人任务中实现了相比原生 GCS 高达两个数量级的加速，同时保持100%成功率，代价是解的最优性有所损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GCS 框架虽然能自然地将离散决策与连续轨迹耦合的运动规划问题公式化，但其所产生的优化子问题在在线重规划场景下计算开销过大，难以满足实时性要求。

Method: 1) 用图注意力网络（GAT）的单次前向传播替代 GCS 中代价高昂的凸松弛步骤，预测高概率候选路径；2) 用轻量级排序网络对候选路径按估计轨迹成本排序；3) 按该顺序评估候选路径，提前终止搜索，同时恢复近最优的运动规划方案。

Result: 在3D四旋翼无障碍运动规划、7自由度机械臂以及平面推挤接触规划等多样机器人任务中，该方法在凸与非凸成本及约束设置下，相比原生 GCS 实现了最高两个数量级的加速，成功率保持100%，但恢复的解存在一定的次优性。

Conclusion: 学习驱动的 GCS 加速策略能够有效弥合 GCS 框架的理论表达力与实际在线计算效率之间的差距，为实时重规划提供了可行的解决方案，代价是解最优性的轻微牺牲。

Abstract: Motion planning problems such as collision-free navigation and contact-rich manipulation can be naturally formulated as optimization problems that couple discrete decisions with continuous trajectories. The Graphs of Convex Sets (GCS) framework offers a practical solution to these problems. It represents discrete decisions as nodes of a graph and encodes continuous trajectories in the edges connecting them. However, the resulting optimization subproblems can become computationally prohibitive for online replanning.
  In this work, we propose a learning-based strategy to mitigate this limitation. Specifically, we replace the costly convex relaxation step required by nominal GCS with a single forward pass through a Graph Attention Network that predicts a set of highly probable candidate paths through the graph. A lightweight ranking network then orders these candidates by their estimated trajectory cost. Evaluating them in this order, we terminate our search early while still recovering a near-optimal motion plan. We validate the resulting pipeline across diverse robotic tasks, including collision-free motion planning for a 3D quadrotor and a 7-DoF manipulator, and planning through contact for planar pushing. Across both convex and non-convex cost and constraint settings, our approach yields up to two orders of magnitude speedup over nominal GCS while maintaining a 100% success rate, at the cost of some suboptimality in the recovered solutions. Code implementations and video demonstrations can be found at https://neural-gcs.github.io/.

</details>


### [445] [GUIDER: Evaluating Goal-Free Human Intent Inference for Teleoperated Manipulation on Real-Robot Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15446)
*Nicholas Kenny,Cesar Alan Contreras,Basile Ouedraogo,Rustam Stolkin,Manolis Chiou,Maria Kyrarini*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文在机器人操作场景中对一种无目标（goal-free）的概率框架GUIDER进行人机意图推断评估，覆盖泡茶和取药等辅助场景，并在20个操作步骤中全部正确估计了人类意图，平均置信预测时间为3.7秒，预测稳定性达96.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在机器人辅助操作中，准确推断人类意图至关重要，但现有方法往往依赖预设目标（goal-based），缺乏灵活性和鲁棒性。因此作者提出并评估一种无目标的概率意图推断框架，以适应多样化的辅助任务场景。

Method: 部署GUIDER框架在机械臂采集的数据上，测试操作阶段的各种辅助场景。添加了在线概率更新、工作空间限制、支撑平面过滤和优先考虑可行抓取区域的抓取模式，并在保留原始时间条件下对记录数据进行测试。

Result: 在三个场景共20个操作步骤中，GUIDER在所有情况下均将人类意图估计在正确的抓取候选集内；达到置信预测的时间为3.7秒，首次抓取前剩余时间为49.6秒，预测稳定性96.4%，每个感知阶段意图的运行时均值为4.857秒、中位数为4.474秒。

Conclusion: GUIDER在机器人操作的人机意图推断中表现出高准确性和实时性，验证了无目标概率框架在该领域的可行性与有效性，为后续机器人辅助应用提供了可靠基础。

Abstract: This paper presents an evaluation of a goal-free probabilistic framework for human intent inference during robotic manipulation. We deploy the Global User Intent Dual-phase Estimation for Robots (GUIDER) on data collected from a robotic arm to test the manipulation phase across various assistance scenarios, including making tea and fetching medicine. To support operation, we add online probability updates, workspace limits, support-plane filtering, and a grasping mode that prioritizes feasible grasp regions, all of which are tested on the recorded data while preserving its original temporal conditions. Across 20 manipulation steps in three scenarios, GUIDER estimated human intent within the correct grasp-candidate set in all cases and achieved a time to confident prediction of 3.7 s, a remaining time before first grasp of 49.6 s, a prediction stability of 96.4%, and a runtime of 4.857/4.474 s (mean/median) per perceptual phase of intent.

</details>


### [446] [Detachable Wire Drive : Reconfigurable Robot Architecture with Shared Actuators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15461)
*Takahiro Hattori,Kento Kawaharazuka,Kei Okada*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为"可分离线驱动"(Detachable Wire Drive)的可重构机器人系统，通过"线分离单元"(Wire Detach Unit)机制实现重型且昂贵的执行器在不同机器人形态之间共享。该系统开发了2自由度刚性臂、连续体臂和两种不同夹爪，均可互换地连接到单一共享执行器组并由其驱动。实验验证了分离过程的机械可靠性和控制系统无缝管理形态间切换的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统可重构机器人的集中式架构通常需要为每个模块配备专用执行器，导致系统整体重量、体积和成本显著增加。作者旨在通过共享重型且昂贵的执行器来解决这一资源浪费问题。

Method: 提出了"可分离线驱动"系统，核心是"线分离单元"机制，能够物理上拆分和重新连接线驱动路径，使电机能够整合到共用的基座单元中。基于此，开发了2自由度刚性臂、连续体臂和两种不同夹爪，均可互换地连接到同一共享执行器组。

Result: 实验验证了分离过程的机械可靠性，以及控制系统能够无缝管理不同形态之间切换的能力，证明了该系统在实现高效、多功能机器人系统方面的有效性。

Conclusion: 该工作展示了一条通往更高效、更具多功能性的机器人系统的路径，通过共享执行器显著降低系统成本、重量和体积，为可重构机器人提供了新的设计思路。

Abstract: Reconfigurable robots offer significant potential for adapting to diverse tasks; however, conventional centralized architectures often require dedicated actuators for each module, leading to substantial increases in overall system weight, volume, and cost. To address these challenges, this paper presents the "Detachable Wire Drive," a reconfigurable robotic system that enables the sharing of heavy and expensive actuators across various morphologies. The core of this system is the "Wire Detach Unit," a mechanism designed to physically split and reconnect wire drive paths, allowing motors to be consolidated into a common base unit. We demonstrate the versatility of this approach by developing a 2-DOF rigid arm, a continuum arm, and two distinct grippers, all of which are interchangeably attached to, and driven by, a single shared actuator set. Experimental results validate the mechanical reliability of the detachment process and the control framework's ability to seamlessly manage transitions between configurations, highlighting a path toward more efficient and multi-functional robotic systems.

</details>


### [447] [Vision-Based Tactile Intelligence for Robotics: Sensing, Learning, and Embodied Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15490)
*Peng Zhou,Jun Hu,Sihan Chen,Zeqing Zhang,Haofei Ma,Zhenyu Lu,Sichao Liu,Xueqian Wang,Pai Zheng,Xiang Li,Shan Luo,Jia Pan,David Navarro-Alarcon,Chenguang Yang,Michael Yu Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文全面综述了视觉触觉传感器(VBTS)的完整流水线，将传感硬件、学习方法、仿真和数据集视为一个集成系统，从硬件分类、学习智能层级、仿真与数据扩展三个维度进行梳理，并指出了开放挑战与未来方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统触觉传感器提供的信息稀疏且维度低，难以满足复杂机器人感知与交互的需求。视觉触觉传感器通过将触觉接触变形转化为图像，提供高分辨率、信息丰富的触觉观测，但相关研究分散在硬件、算法、仿真等多个领域，缺乏系统性的整合视角。

Method: 1) 构建硬件分类体系，按弹性体设计、传感器尺寸与形状、光学系统设计三个维度组织代表性VBTS；2) 提出层级化学习智能框架，从低级信号理解到任务级策略再到基础模型；3) 将仿真平台与触觉数据集视为规模化训练层，涵盖sim-to-real迁移与跨传感器适应。

Result: 提供了一套系统化、结构化的VBTS综述框架，覆盖硬件开发指导、学习算法层级划分及数据扩展策略，形成硬件、AI架构、仿真与数据集之间交互的全景视图。

Conclusion: 该综述旨在通过整合视觉触觉传感硬件与学习系统的各个环节，推动接触丰富型机器人任务中的触觉智能发展，并明确了未来研究的关键挑战与方向。

Abstract: Tactile sensing is essential for robots in contact-rich tasks, yet many tactile sensors still provide sparse, low-dimensional signals that do not capture sufficient information for complex robotic perception and interaction. Vision-based tactile sensors (VBTSs) offer a powerful alternative by con-verting contact-induced deformation of a soft interface into im-ages. The image-based formulation gives VBTSs high-resolution, information-rich tactile observations that enable complex robotic tasks. This review surveys the full VBTS pipeline and treats sensing hardware, learning methods, simulation, and datasets as an integrated sensing-and-learning system. We 1) organize representative VBTSs into a hardware taxonomy structured by deformable elastomer design, sensor size and shape, and optical system design to guide future sensor development; 2) present a hierarchical view of learning-based tactile intelligence from low-level signal understanding to task-level policies and foundation models; and 3) examine simulation platforms and tactile datasets as a scaling layer, together with sim-to-real transfer and cross-sensor adaptation for training, benchmarking, and deployment. Finally, we identify open challenges and future directions for VBTSs in robotics. By providing a holistic view of how hardware, AI architectures, simulation, and datasets interact, this review aims to advance tactile intelligence for contact-rich robotic tasks.

</details>


### [448] [Temporal Logic Guided Universal Task Representations for Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15509)
*Hao Zhang,Zhangli Zhou,Zhen Kan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: LOTUS是一个基于时序逻辑(LTL)的通用任务表示框架，可无缝集成到任何RL算法中，通过将LTL编码器视为策略来改进更新机制，并利用双模拟度量(bisimulation metric)提供理论保证，在单任务、多任务和未见操控任务上均显著超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有任务表示算法多为特定场景定制，难以跨场景泛化；且它们依赖强化学习控制器提供的梯度信号来更新权重，这会降低表示质量和学习效率。因此需要一种通用、不依赖RL梯度信号的任务表示框架。

Method: 提出LOTUS框架：(1)设计一种新颖的任务表示架构，能够从LTL公式中建模关系并提取任务语义；(2)引入更有效的更新机制，将LTL编码器视为一个策略(policy)来训练，从而提升表示能力；(3)利用双模拟度量增强稳定性和鲁棒性，为LTL表示提供行为等价性、最优性保真度和轨迹鲁棒性的理论保证。

Result: 实验表明LOTUS在大多数指标上优于现有方法：单任务场景收敛速度提升超过20%；未见操控任务成功率提高15%-45%；在子目标深度增加或合取关系增多的复杂多任务环境中，泛化性能提升超过25%。

Conclusion: LOTUS作为一种通用的、基于LTL的任务表示框架，成功克服了现有方法泛化能力差和对RL梯度依赖的问题，在多种任务场景中验证了其优越的学习效率、泛化能力和表示质量，并提供理论保证支撑其可靠性。

Abstract: Task guided agents demonstrate strong performance in a wide range of complex tasks. However, most existing task representation algorithms are tailored to specific contexts and struggle to generalize across diverse scenarios. Moreover, they typically depend on gradient signals from reinforcement learning controllers to update their weights, which can degrade both representation quality and learning efficiency. To overcome these limitations, we propose LOTUS, a temporal logic inspired universal task representation framework that can be seamlessly integrated into any RL algorithm to enhance agent performance across diverse task settings. Specifically, we design a novel task representation architecture capable of modeling relationships and extracting task semantics from LTL formulas. We further introduce a more effective update mechanism that treats the LTL encoder as a policy, thereby improving representation capacity.
