In this paper, we propose Cyclops, a framework that translates sparse Non-Repetitive Scanning LiDAR (NRS-LiDAR) intensity into RGB video, enabling camera-free inference for all-day perception tasks. Our approach first converts sparse LiDAR intensity projections into dense representations via a frozen pre-trained densification module, serving as a geometrically rich source condition. The dense intensity latent is then transported toward the target RGB distribution through Latent Bridge Matching (LBM) with a learned velocity field in a few ODE integration steps. To mitigate inter-frame flickering, we inject prior-frame context via temporal attention layers and further formulate the velocity field as a policy optimized by a differentiable terminal reward that encourages terminal fidelity through backpropagation along the ODE trajectory. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the synthesized RGB, including those generated under near-dark conditions, enable standard RGB-based perception models to substantially outperform both LiDAR baselines and conventional cameras on semantic segmentation, lane detection, and point cloud colorization across diverse lighting conditions.

</details>


### [483] [Marker-Constrained Pose-Graph Correction for Cross-Platform Georeferencing in GNSS-Denied Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16281)
*Marco Giberna,Jose Luis Sanchez Lopez,Holger Voos*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种在无GNSS环境下，利用伪装匹配的胆甾球形反射器（CSR）标记物作为预测绘视觉锚点，将轻量级LiDAR里程计轨迹和RTAB-Map稠密重建统一地理参考到LUREF坐标系的方法，通过粗相似性对齐与标记约束的位姿图优化实现。实验显示重访不一致性降低97.9%和99.1%，跨会话稠密重建中位最近邻距离为58cm。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在GNSS不可用的环境中（如室内、地下或信号干扰场景），自主系统需要异构建图管线维持一致的空间参考，但缺乏统一的定位基准导致轨迹和重建地图难以对齐。现有方法依赖GNSS，在GNSS拒止环境下无法实现地理参考。

Method: 1) 使用伪装匹配的CSR（胆甾球形反射器）标记物作为预测绘视觉锚点；2) 结合粗相似性对齐与标记约束的位姿图优化，将LiDAR里程计轨迹和RTAB-Map稠密重建共同地理参考到LUREF帧；3) 使用手持采集设备模拟UGV和UAV运动轨迹进行验证。

Result: 单标记在6个位置间移动，首位置重访用于量化漂移校正。标记锚点校正使UAV和UGV模拟会话的重访不一致性分别降低97.9%和99.1%，并改善预留锚点预测精度。独立地理参考的稠密重建跨会话中位最近邻距离58cm。标记处理实时运行，轨迹校正每会话小于0.25秒。

Conclusion: 该框架证明了一种概念验证：在GNSS拒止操作期间，使用视觉上不显眼、预测绘的锚点可实现对轻量级里程计和稠密重建的地理参考，且精度和实时性均有保障。

Abstract: Autonomous operation in GNSS-denied environments requires heterogeneous mapping pipelines to maintain a consistent spatial reference. This paper presents a framework using camouflage-matched fiducial markers fabricated from Cholesteric Spherical Reflectors (CSRs) as pre-surveyed visual anchors. The anchors georeference both a lightweight LiDAR-odometry trajectory and a dense RTAB-Map reconstruction, allowing their outputs to be expressed in a common LUREF frame (geodetic coordinate reference system used in Luxembourg) without requiring GNSS measurements during operation. The method combines coarse similarity alignment with marker-constrained pose-graph optimization. We evaluate it using two handheld acquisition sessions with ground-level and elevated motion profiles emulating UGV and UAV operation. A single iMarker was relocated among six surveyed positions, with the first position revisited to quantify drift correction. Marker-anchor correction reduced revisit inconsistency by 97.9% and 99.1% for the UAV- and UGV-emulating sessions, respectively, and improved held-out anchor prediction compared with one-time alignment. Separately georeferenced dense reconstructions achieved a median cross-session nearest-neighbour distance of 58 cm without explicit cross-session registration. Marker processing operated in real time, while trajectory correction required less than 0.25 s per session. These results demonstrate a proof of concept for georeferencing lightweight odometry and dense reconstructions using visually unobtrusive, pre-surveyed anchors during GNSS-denied operation.

</details>


### [484] [Readiness Barrier Functions: Forward-Invariant Control Authority for Overactuated Multirotor Allocation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16335)
*Giuseppe Silano*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于控制障碍函数（CBF）的分配方案，将作动器权威性（authority）视为前向不变量，通过在分配零空间中施加二次规划（QP）约束，在扭矩层面强制执行对数行列式权威度量的下界，从而在保持跟踪性能的同时保证权威性的硬化保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 过驱动多旋翼的两种现有分配方案各有缺陷：贪心最大化就绪度量（readiness metric）的方案在最优层之间跳变，产生任何电机都无法提供的作动器速率需求；而最小化力矩（effort-minimizing）方案虽然连续，但无法保证扭矩率权威性（wrench-rate authority）保持在任何认证水平以上。因此需要一种兼具连续性与权威性保证的方案。

Method: 将权威性视为前向不变量，即作为拖拽感知的作动器权威共度量（drag-aware actuator-authority co-metric）对数行列式的控制障碍函数，在分配零空间中通过二次规划在扭矩层面执行。通过单一设计不等式使认证集紧凑且严格位于作动器边界内部；给出对称设计中任何转子停用的就绪代价闭式解为ln(n/(n-m))；跟踪误差以显式对齐比率（alignment ratio）为代价，力矩误差有O(ρ^{-1/2})界；鲁棒变体以独立于机体矩阵的闭式地板偏移量处理电机参数不确定性。

Result: 在六旋翼和全驱动八旋翼上，闭式间隙与仿真结果达到机器精度一致；在权威性稀缺情形下，贪心最大化违反认证地板并产生比所提滤波器大八十倍的力矩误差，而所提滤波器以可忽略的跟踪代价保持认证集的不变性。

Conclusion: 该CBF-based滤波器能在权威性稀缺时保持认证集的硬性不变性保证，同时跟踪代价可忽略，优于贪心最大化方案；且闭式分析与仿真高度吻合，鲁棒变体可处理参数不确定性。

Abstract: Allocation schemes that greedily maximize a readiness metric over the actuator fiber bundle of an overactuated multirotor produce commands that jump between disconnected optimal strata, demanding actuator rates no motor can deliver; effort-minimizing schemes are continuous but cannot guarantee that wrench-rate authority stays above any certified level. We reconcile the two by treating authority as a forward-invariant quantity: a control barrier function on the log-determinant of the drag-aware actuator-authority co-metric, enforced at torque level by a quadratic program in the allocation null space. A single design inequality renders the certified set compact and strictly interior to the actuator box, with the readiness cost of any rotor deactivation given in closed form as $\ln(n/(n{-}m))$ for symmetric designs. Tracking is sacrificed only through an explicit alignment ratio, with wrench error bounded by $\mathcal{O}(ρ^{-1/2})$ and a robust variant handles motor-parameter uncertainty with a closed-form floor shift independent of the airframe matrix. On a hexarotor and a fully-actuated octorotor the closed-form gap matches simulation to machine precision; in the authority-scarce regime greedy maximization violates the certified floor and commits wrench errors up to eighty times larger than the proposed filter, which holds invariance of the certified set at negligible tracking cost.

</details>


### [485] [Arm-Aware Guided Dexterous Grasp Generation with Arm-Agnostic Grasp Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16351)
*Yongyi Jia,Yongpeng Jiang,Kangchen Lv,Yi Ren,Mingrui Yu,Xiang Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种臂感知的灵巧抓取生成框架，利用预训练的臂无关抓取模型，仅在推理时整合手臂和环境信息，无需重新训练或拒绝采样。该方法将臂约束抓取生成形式化为手部姿态与手臂构型的联合优化，并推导了闭式梯度，证明基于梯度的优化等价于引导式扩散采样。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实场景中（如手臂避障、工作空间边界抓取、连续抓取）必须考虑手臂相关约束，而现有手中心抓取模型仅关注浮动手部姿态，不足以应对这些场景。已有的臂感知方法要么依赖拒绝采样丢弃不可行样本（低采样效率），要么需要在特定手臂数据上重新训练（跨机器人/环境泛化差）。

Method: 提出臂感知灵巧抓取生成框架：1) 将臂约束抓取生成形式化为手部姿态与手臂配置的联合优化问题；2) 为手臂相关约束推导闭式梯度；3) 假设手部姿态分布由扩散模型表示，证明基于梯度的优化等价于引导式扩散采样，可将接近可行的样本引导至可行区域。

Result: 在涵盖6种场景、10k个物体的综合评估中，所提框架在高度约束环境下生成可行抓取的概率显著更高，验证了其在真实应用中的优势。

Conclusion: 该框架通过推理时集成臂与环境信息的方式，绕过了重新训练和拒绝采样的缺陷，实现了高效率与良好泛化性的兼备，为臂感知抓取生成提供了新的解决思路。

Abstract: Dexterous grasp generation that considers arm-related constraints is crucial in real-world scenarios involving arm environment collision avoidance, workspace boundary grasps, and consecutive grasping. Existing hand-centric grasp models, which primarily focus on the floating hand's pose, are insufficient for such cases. Conventional arm-aware methods either rely on rejection sampling to discard infeasible samples or require retraining on arm-specific data, leading to low sample efficiency under adverse conditions or limited generalization across different robots and environments. To overcome these limitations, this letter presents an arm-aware dexterous grasp generation framework that leverages pretrained arm-agnostic grasp models while integrating arm and environmental information only at inference time. Specifically, we formulate arm-aware constrained grasp generation as a joint optimization of hand pose and arm configuration, and derive closed-form gradients for arm-related constraints. Assuming the hand pose distribution is represented by a diffusion model, we prove that gradient-based optimization is equivalent to guided diffusion sampling, steering near-feasible samples toward the feasible region. Through comprehensive evaluation involving 10k objects across 6 scenarios, we demonstrate that the proposed framework generates feasible grasps in highly constrained settings with significantly higher probability, highlighting its advantages in real-world applications. Supplementary materials and appendix are available at https://arm-aware-dexgrasp.github.io/.

</details>


### [486] [Robot-Body-Aware Traversal Risk Graph Planning for Wheeled-Legged Robots in Complex Terrain](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16433)
*Zhiqiao Guo,Bichi Zhang,Sören Schwertfeger*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出RB-TRG，一种针对轮腿机器人的机身感知轨迹风险图规划方法。它在稀疏TRG表示基础上，将边级地形风险搜索提升为航向和转向感知的机身风险转移，通过沿图边和偏航扫描采样朝向矩形足印，测量纵向支撑变化、横向倾斜、地形干扰及不可信地图区域暴露。该方法在四个扫描地形环境和闭环MuJoCo试验中验证，将端到端成功率从51.5%提升至68.5%，平均路径长度仅增加2.3%，并在IEEE ICRA 2026腿式机器人挑战赛中获得最佳自主性和最佳机动性奖项。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统TRG基于圆形节点邻域和边对齐地形区域计算成本，忽略了轮腿机器人的朝向机身足印，导致在转向时可能遗漏部分支撑损失和机身高程，造成身体与地形干扰。

Method: 在稀疏TRG表示上，沿图边和偏航扫描采样朝向矩形足印，测量纵向支撑变化、横向倾斜、地形干扰和不可信地图区域暴露；提取均值与上尾特征纳入转移成本，通过A*在有序节点对状态上最小化累积值，保持TRG构建与规划接口不变。

Result: 在四个扫描地形环境的同图研究和配对闭环MuJoCo试验中，RB-TRG降低了三个核心几何机身放置指标，端到端成功率从51.5%提升至68.5%，平均路径长度仅增加2.3%。Go2-W实际部署搭配完整LiDAR导航栈，获得ICRA 2026 Legged Robot Challenges最佳自主性和最佳机动性奖。

Conclusion: RB-TRG以紧凑的稀疏表示实现了面向机身的方向与转向感知规划，在不显著增加路径长度的情况下显著提升轮腿机器人全局导航的安全性与成功率，并在真实部署中得到验证。

Abstract: Traversal Risk Graphs (TRGs) provide a compact, terrain-aware representation for global navigation, but native TRG costs are computed over circular node neighborhoods and edge-aligned terrain regions rather than the robot's oriented body footprint. For wheeled-legged robots, this abstraction can miss partial support loss and body-terrain interference, especially during turns. We present Robot-Body-Aware TRG planning (RB-TRG), which builds on the sparse TRG representation and lifts edge-wise terrain-risk search to heading- and turn-aware body-risk transitions. An oriented rectangular footprint is sampled along graph edges and yaw sweeps to measure longitudinal support variation, lateral inclination, terrain interference, and exposure to untrusted map regions. Mean-and-upper-tail features are incorporated into transition costs, whose accumulated value is minimized by A* over ordered node-pair states, preserving TRG construction and its planning interface. We evaluate RB-TRG in a same-graph study on four scanned terrain environments and in paired closed-loop MuJoCo trials. RB-TRG reduces the three core geometric body-placement metrics and increases end-to-end success from 51.5% to 68.5%, while increasing mean path length by 2.3%. A Go2-W deployment further demonstrates RB-TRG with a full LiDAR navigation stack, which received the Best Autonomy and Best Mobility awards at the IEEE ICRA 2026 Legged Robot Challenges. The code for RB-TRG is released at https://github.com/ZhiqiaoGuo/RB-TRG.

</details>


### [487] [Observation-Constrained Joint-Space Viewpoint Optimization for Robotic Inspection of Cylindrical Cavities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16442)
*Yuezhong Wang,Rongshen Yin,Bichi Zhang,Sören Schwertfeger*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种在机器人关节空间中全自动完成圆柱空腔观测受限巡检的方法。该方法将观测目标表示为有效的观察几何集合，而非单一笛卡尔相机位姿，从而避免拒绝可达视点和关节极限裕度差的构型。结合RGB感知前端（弧支撑椭圆拟合估计开口中心和腔体轴）与多起点无导数搜索，在满足约束的前提下优化关节构型，并通过碰撞感知运动规划和射线法底部可见性验证。Isaac Sim中100个目标构型完成92个，平均底部可见性91.65%；桌面和Unitree A2挂载实验验证了完整pipeline。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动机器人巡检常需观测圆柱空腔底部（如ASTM搜索任务基准），该任务要求机器人精确定位相机，同时满足可见性、运动学和碰撞约束。传统方法仅规定单一笛卡尔相机位姿，会排除许多可达视点和关节极限裕度良好的构型，导致任务成功率受限。

Method: 1) 将观测目标表示为有效的观察几何集合（相机轴对齐、侧向偏移、轴向间距约束）而非单一位姿；2) RGB感知前端通过语义掩膜的弧支撑椭圆拟合估计开口中心和腔体方向轴；3) 多起点无导数搜索按字典序优先级优化关节构型（约束满足优先，其次评估运动经济性、关节极限裕度和视图质量）；4) 碰撞感知运动规划器评估候选方案，执行后通过几何和射线法验证底部可见性。

Result: Isaac Sim仿真中：提出方法在100个目标构型中成功完成92个，平均底部可见性91.65%；对比基线（多起点坐标搜索）仅完成76个、可见性84.3%。桌面实验和Unitee A2挂载实验验证了完整感知-规划-执行流水线的可行性。

Conclusion: 将观测目标建模为有效观察几何集合而非单一笛卡尔位姿，能够显著提升圆柱空腔巡检的自主性和成功率，在仿真与实物实验中均验证了方法的有效性与鲁棒性。

Abstract: Inspection is a core capability in many mobile robotics applications, including industrial facility monitoring, infrastructure maintenance, agriculture, and search and rescue. Observing the bottom of a cylindrical cavity, as required by ASTM search-task benchmarks for response robots, presents a representative challenge: the robot must position its camera precisely while satisfying visibility, kinematic, and collision constraints. This paper presents a fully autonomous method for observation-constrained inspection of cylindrical cavities in robot joint space. Rather than prescribing a single Cartesian camera pose, the method represents the inspection objective as a set of valid viewing geometries, thereby avoiding the rejection of reachable viewpoints and configurations with poor joint-limit margins. An RGB perception front end estimates the opening center and directed cavity axis from semantic masks using arc-supported ellipse fitting together with body and side-generator cues. These estimates parameterize constraints on camera-axis alignment, lateral offset, and axial standoff. A multistart derivative-free search then optimizes robot joint configurations with lexicographic priority given to constraint satisfaction; feasible configurations are ranked according to motion economy, joint-limit margin, and view quality. The resulting candidates are evaluated by a collision-aware motion planner, and the executed camera pose is verified geometrically and using a ray-based estimate of bottom visibility. In Isaac Sim, the proposed method successfully completes 92 of 100 target configurations and attains 91.65% mean bottom visibility among executed trials, compared with 76 of 100 and 84.3% for a multistart coordinate-search baseline. Tabletop and Unitree A2-mounted experiments demonstrate the complete perception-planning-execution pipeline.

</details>


### [488] [Exposing the Long-tail in Embodied Urban Navigation via Scalable Learning from In-the-Wild Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16476)
*Bingyi Xia,Han Bao,Zhewei Chen,Hanjing Ye,Jingwen Yu,Yuhan Pang,Wenjun Xu,Jiankun Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一个可扩展框架，利用网络规模的野生第一人称视频学习城市点目标导航策略，同时系统地暴露其长尾分布。框架自动标注非结构化网络视频（指标轨迹和导航语义），训练视觉-语言-动作策略，并基于模型性能和感知-运动模式分布刻画长尾，通过反思分析诊断重复失败模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从真实世界数据学习具身城市导航策略受到两方面的制约：任务特定数据收集的成本高昂，以及罕见但安全关键的场景覆盖不足（即长尾问题）。

Method: 1) 自动标注非结构化的网络视频，赋予其度量轨迹和结构化导航语义；2) 用标注数据训练视觉-语言-动作(VLA)策略以进行可解释的导航规划；3) 基于模型性能与感知-运动模式分布刻画长尾；4) 采用反思式分析诊断重复出现的失败模式。

Result: 在web视频数据和真实城市导航任务上的实验表明：能够从无约束视频中有效迁移知识，并揭示出超越聚合导航性能的长尾结构。

Conclusion: 所提框架能够低成本利用海量网络视频数据学习城市导航策略，并系统性暴露、诊断长尾中罕见但关键的安全场景，为具身导航策略的鲁棒性与可解释性提供了新的路径。

Abstract: Learning embodied urban navigation policies from real-world data is constrained by the cost of task-specific data collection and the limited coverage of rare yet safety-critical scenarios. To address these challenges, we present a scalable framework for learning point-goal urban navigation from web-scale in-the-wild egocentric videos while systematically exposing its long tail. The framework automatically annotates uncurated web videos with metric trajectories and structured navigation semantics, which are then used to train a vision-language-action policy for interpretable navigation planning. We characterize the long tail based on model performance and the distribution of perception-motion patterns, and employ reflection-based analysis to diagnose recurring failure modes. Experiments on web-video data and real-world urban navigation tasks demonstrate effective knowledge transfer from unconstrained videos and reveal coherent long-tail structures beyond aggregate navigation performance.

</details>


### [489] [OccamView: Object-Conditioned View Selection for Frame-Budgeted Active 3D Gaussian Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16499)
*Hongbo Gao,Wei Zhang,Zeyu Ni,Dihao Zhu,Ruifeng Li,Yunke Wang,Chang Xu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: OccamView是一个面向帧预算受限的主动3D高斯重建的物体条件视图选择框架。它利用开放词汇检测维护在线物体记忆，将物体周围的未解析局部占用表示为保守的隐藏区域代理，并通过遮挡感知的代理覆盖率评分来评估候选视角，同时引入Geo-Floor机制在几何竞争性候选中进行物体条件重排序。在Replica和Matterport3D基准上，该方法在五个帧预算下一致提升了重建完整度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有主动3DGS方法主要根据几何信息增益规划视角，将物体引起的隐藏区域与一般未探索空间同等对待。在紧凑帧预算下，纯几何驱动策略可能优先覆盖全局场景，导致部分观察物体重建不完整。

Method: 1) 从开放词汇检测中维护在线物体记忆（基于实测RGB-D观测，不预测未见物体几何）；2) 将检测物体周围的未解析局部占用表示为保守隐藏区域代理；3) 使用遮挡感知的代理覆盖率评分评估候选视角；4) 引入Geo-Floor机制，仅对几何上有竞争力的候选进行物体条件重排序，保持底层规划器的几何驱动探索行为。

Result: 在Replica和Matterport3D数据集上的统一帧预算协议下，OccamView在五个帧预算中一致降低Completion并提高Completion Ratio，在帧预算有限时提升尤为显著。

Conclusion: 轻量的物体条件线索可以有效补充几何驱动的主动视图规划，在有限预算下显著提升物体感知的重建质量，而无需复杂的物体形状补全或几何预测。

Abstract: Active 3D Gaussian reconstruction fundamentally relies on selecting informative next-best views under limited sensing budgets. Existing active 3DGS methods primarily plan viewpoints according to geometric information gain, treating object-induced hidden regions in the same manner as general unexplored space. Under tight frame budgets, such geometry-driven strategies may prioritize global scene coverage while leaving partially observed objects incompletely reconstructed. To address this limitation, we propose OccamView, an object-conditioned view-selection framework for frame-budgeted active 3D Gaussian reconstruction. Rather than predicting unseen object geometry or performing shape completion, OccamView maintains an online object memory from open-vocabulary detections grounded in measured RGB-D observations and represents unresolved local occupancy around detected objects as conservative hidden-region proxies. Candidate viewpoints are then evaluated using an occlusion-aware proxy-coverage score. Furthermore, we introduce a Geo-Floor mechanism that restricts object-conditioned re-ranking to geometrically competitive candidates, allowing object-conditioned cues to guide complementary observations while preserving the geometry-driven exploration behavior of the underlying planner. Experiments on Replica and Matterport3D under a unified frame-budgeted protocol show that OccamView consistently reduces Completion and improves Completion Ratio across five frame budgets, with particularly pronounced gains under limited frame budgets. These results demonstrate that lightweight object-conditioned cues effectively complement geometry-driven active view planning.

</details>


### [490] [NebulaVLA: A Dual-Frequency Vision-Language-Action Model With Guide Action for Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16503)
*Cong Zhao,Shuai Tian,Xu Zhang,Baocheng Ni,Xinguo Song,Xueying Sun,Shu Jiang,Shouchang Yang,Bo Tang,Jin Deng,Ge Zhu,YongCheng Wang,Jin Xu,Ri Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出NebulaVLA，一种异步双频架构，将高层语义推理与低层动作控制解耦，结合统一语言接地动作表示GESTURE-7和Guide Action平滑算法，在LIBERO-Plus上达到85.5%的平均成功率，动作生成速度提升约2.7倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实世界中部署视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型常受限于效率与性能的权衡、跨实体泛化能力不足以及执行平滑性问题，亟需一种兼顾效率、泛化与流畅性的解决方案。

Method: 1) 提出NebulaVLA异步双频架构，分离高层语义推理与低层动作控制；2) 引入GESTURE-7统一语言接地的动作表示，弥合异构机器人间的语义鸿沟；3) 设计Guide Action算法，通过基于掩码的平滑性约束保证运动学连续性。

Result: 在LIBERO-Plus基准上平均成功率85.5%，显著优于同步基线；动作生成速度提升约2.7倍，验证了异步设计的效率优势。

Conclusion: 异步双频架构能够实现高效且响应式控制的实用机器人部署，为VLA模型在实际场景中的应用提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Real-world deployment of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models is often bottlenecked by efficiency-performance trade-offs, cross-embodiment generalization, and execution smoothness. We present NebulaVLA, an asynchronous dual-frequency architecture that decouples high-level semantic reasoning from low-level action control, optimizing computational resources and modularity. To bridge semantic gaps across heterogeneous robots, we introduce GESTURE-7, a unified language-grounded action representation. Furthermore, our Guide Action algorithm enforces kinematic continuity via mask-based smoothness constraints. Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that NebulaVLA significantly outperforms synchronous baselines, achieving an 85.5\% average success rate on LIBERO-Plus and accelerating action generation by \textasciitilde 2.7$\times$. This asynchronous design enables highly efficient and responsive control for practical robotics.

</details>


### [491] [Co-design of Neural and Muscle Network based on Embodied Perceptron Representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16555)
*Siyuan Tao,Yoichi Masuda,Hiroyuki Nabae,Masato Ishikawa*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出"具身感知机"（Embodied Perceptron）理论框架，将物理身体系统统一建模为神经网络形式，其中机械参数对应权重、物理非线性对应激活函数，从而在理论上解释身体如何替代部分神经控制。作为应用，该方法在肌肉骨骼机器人上联合优化控制策略与肌肉配置，即使使用单神经元控制器也能获得固有稳定性、提高学习效率并大幅缩小模型规模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI技术虽能设计复杂控制策略，但许多机器人仍采用简单身体结构，限制了环境适应性。具身机器人学研究表明精心设计的身体可通过物理交互部分替代控制与计算的作用，但这类设计严重依赖专家直觉。因此需要系统性的身体设计理论框架，以及身体与控制器联合优化的方法。

Method: 提出"具身感知机"框架：将物理身体视为一个感知机，机械参数映射为权重，物理非线性映射为激活函数；将物理约束表示为权重、非线性属性表示为激活函数，使物理身体可以以神经网络形式建模。基于该表示可显式地从理论上解释身体如何替代部分神经控制，并据此在肌肉骨骼机器人上联合优化控制策略与肌肉配置。

Result: 在肌肉骨骼机器人上联合优化控制策略与肌肉配置后，所得的具身智能能够提供固有稳定性、提高学习效率，并大幅缩减模型规模——即使使用单神经元控制器也能实现良好性能。

Conclusion: 该工作弥合了信息世界与物理世界之间的鸿沟，为理解和系统化设计具身AI系统提供了一条新路径。

Abstract: Recent advances in AI technologies have enabled the advanced design of complex control policies. In contrast, focusing on the body, many robots still employ simple bodies that can limit adaptability to environments. Studies in embodied robotics have shown that well-designed bodies can partially replace the role of control and computation with physical body-environment interactions, yet such designs still depend heavily on expert intuition. There is a need for a systematic theoretical framework for body design, as well as a method for joint optimization of the body and controller. To address this, we introduce the Embodied Perceptron, a theoretical framework that unifies neural networks and physical body systems. In this view, the body itself acts as a perceptron: mechanical parameters correspond to weights, and physical nonlinearities play the role of activation functions. By representing physical constraints as weights and nonlinear properties as activation functions, a physical body can be modeled in neural-network form. The system representation enables us to explicitly and theoretically explain that the body can substitute for part of the neural control. As an application, we co-optimize control policy and muscle configuration in a musculoskeletal robot and show that the resulting embodied intelligence can provide inherent stability, improve learning efficiency, and drastically reduce model size-even with a single-neuron controller. The results bridge the informational and physical worlds and provide a pathway toward understanding and systematic design of embodied AI systems.

</details>


### [492] [ViHaTeleop: A Low-Cost, Lightweight Visual-Haptic Teleoperation System for Dexterous Manipulation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16572)
*Fucai Zhu,Yanhou Lai,Paul Maestre,Koichi Hashimoto*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出ViHaTeleop，一个轻量（0.7kg）、低成本（$550）的视觉-触觉遥操作系统，结合SLAM腕部追踪、摄像头手部追踪和基于LRA的指级振动触觉反馈，用于灵巧操作的接触关键任务演示采集，并验证了触觉反馈对操作成功率和主观体验的提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从演示中学习是灵巧操作的有效方法，但使用低成本遥操作硬件采集高质量的接触关键演示很困难，现有系统缺乏有效的触觉反馈，导致操作员在接触关键任务中难以感知交互状态。

Method: 设计轻量低成本系统ViHaTeleop：SLAM腕部追踪+摄像头手部追踪+通过LRA实现逐指振动触觉反馈；包含LED照明、鱼眼手部相机和触觉感知重定向约束等设计选择；部署于Franka+LEAP Hand+9DTact，并在Isaac Sim中集成基于深度相机的触觉代理，实现从演示采集到视觉-触觉策略训练的完整流程。

Result: 在六项接触关键任务中，9名参与者的对比实验显示触觉反馈在所有任务中均提升成功率（+2.2至+15.6个百分点），完成时间影响因任务而异；主观评分显示接触清晰度和抓取信心显著提升（p<0.05）；下游策略训练验证触觉线索在peg-in-hole任务中较纯视觉提升17个百分点。

Conclusion: ViHaTeleop验证了低成本触觉遥操作系统的可行性，触觉反馈能有效提升接触关键任务的演示质量和后续策略学习效果，为灵巧操作的数据采集提供了经济实用方案。

Abstract: Learning from demonstration is a promising approach for dexterous manipulation, but collecting high-quality contact-critical demonstrations remains difficult with low-cost teleoperation hardware. We present ViHaTeleop, a lightweight (0.7 kg), low-cost (\$550) visual-haptic teleoperation system with SLAM-based wrist tracking, camera-based hand tracking, and finger-wise vibrotactile feedback through Linear Resonant Actuators (LRA). The system includes several design choices (LED illumination, fisheye hand camera, and tactile-aware retargeting constraints) and is deployed on Franka + LEAP Hand + 9DTact in both real and simulated environments. Under matched with/without-haptic conditions with nine participants across six contact-critical tasks, haptics improved success rates across all tasks (+2.2 to +15.6 percentage points), while completion-time effects were task-dependent. Subjective ratings showed significant gains in contact clarity and grasp confidence in both simulation and real-world settings (Wilcoxon signed-rank, $p<0.05$). We also integrate a lightweight depth-camera-based tactile proxy in Isaac Sim, enabling a full pipeline from multi-modal demonstration collection to visual-tactile policy training. Preliminary downstream validation by training visual-tactile policies from collected demonstrations shows tactile cues benefit contact-critical subtasks (peg-in-hole: +17 percentage points over vision-only).

</details>


### [493] [Zetta $ζ$: An Efficient Closed-Loop Embodied Harness for Self-Evolving Physical Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16590)
*Xin Ding,Liang Mi,Mingzhe Huang,Zixuan Wang,Chao Zhang,Zixu Hao,Fu Chen,Xiangyu Li,Yikai Zheng,Yaoyu Guo,Weijun Wang,Kun Li,Hao Wu,Yunxin Liu,Ting Cao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Zetta是一个闭环具身智能体框架，通过三个时间尺度分离的循环实现在线演化代码型运行时评判器和恢复技能，同时保持基础策略冻结，在LIBERO-Pro和RoboCasa上达到SOTA成功率（90.8%和93.6%），推理速度提升11.1倍，并展现出零样本迁移和自探索扩展能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的具身智能体框架在物理执行中缺乏闭环学习：它们本质上是开环的，遵循固定技能执行rollout，仅在回合结束后进行反思。这种事后反思无法在执行过程中动态管控，因为物理交互要求决策频率远高于当前大型智能体模型的能力。

Method: Zetta通过三个时间尺度分离的闭环实现自我演化：1）动作频率治理循环；2）rollout级别的评判器-恢复提议循环；3）验证门控的技能更新循环。同时配合Z-Infra基础设施，将智能体逻辑与异构执行资源解耦。整个过程中基础策略保持冻结，仅在线演化代码型评判器和恢复技能。

Result: 在LIBERO-Pro达到90.8%、RoboCasa达到93.6%的SOTA成功率，推理加速11.1倍；成功随自探索经验持续扩展；学习到的技能可零样本迁移；出现了清晰的机器人"Aha时刻"。

Conclusion: 闭环harness的自我演化开辟了可靠物理智能的扩展路径，证明了无需更新基础策略即可通过在线演化的运行时组件实现可扩展、可靠和迁移的物理执行能力。

Abstract: Embodied agents are increasingly used to close the gap left by end-to-end policy models. Yet the agentic path has not realized closed-loop learning in physical execution: existing harnesses remain largely open-loop, following fixed skills during rollout and reflecting only after an episode completes. Such post-hoc reflection cannot govern execution as it unfolds, because physical interaction requires decisions to track rapidly changing robot-environment states at a frequency beyond today's large agentic models. We present Zetta, a closed-loop embodied harness that evolves code-based runtime critics and recovery skills online while keeping the base policy frozen. Through three timescale-separated loops, Zetta provides action-frequency governance, rollout-level critic-recovery proposal, and validation-gated skill updates. Together with Z-Infra, a rollout infrastructure decoupling agent logic from heterogeneous execution resources, Zetta achieves state-of-the-art success on LIBERO-Pro and RoboCasa under our current rollout budget, reaching 90.8% and 93.6%, with an 11.1x inference speedup; success continues to scale with self-exploration experience; learned skills transfer zero-shot, and clear robotic "Aha Moments" emerge. These results show that closed-loop harness self-evolution opens a scaling path for reliable physical intelligence.

</details>


### [494] [DPNet: Efficient Dead-End Prediction and Avoidance for Vision-Based UAV Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16640)
*Ruibin Zhang,Lun Pan,Zelong Xia,Jialiang Hou,Fei Gao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于视觉的无人机死角预测与规避系统，通过轻量级神经网络利用RGB-D输入预测潜在死角的相对距离和方位，剪枝轨迹库以实现主动规避，无需人工标注即可迁移到真实场景，并以50Hz高频重规划运行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于视觉的无人机在死角（dead ends）场景中常因传感精度和范围有限而导航失败，现有方法缺乏对死角的主动预测与规避机制。

Method: 1) 提出轻量级神经网络，利用RGB-D输入预测当前视场中潜在死角的相对距离与方位；2) 基于预测结果剪枝预定义的紧凑轨迹库，使规划器能主动规避死角并保持导航平滑性；3) 无需真实数据标注或微调即可跨场景迁移。

Result: 系统在机载实现50Hz高频重规划；大规模仿真基准测试在成功率、飞行时间和轨迹长度上均表现优越；真实世界实验在复杂场景中验证了系统有效性。

Conclusion: 所提出的系统有效解决了视觉无人机在死角场景中的导航失败问题，通过预测驱动的轨迹剪枝实现了主动规避，且具备良好的跨场景泛化能力，适合机载实时部署。

Abstract: Vision-based Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) often suffer from navigation failures in dead ends due to limited sensing accuracy and range. To address this challenge, this paper proposes a systematic solution for efficient dead-end prediction and avoidance. The proposed method introduces a lightweight neural network to predict the relative distance and bearing of potential dead ends within the current field of view using RGB-D inputs. These predictions prune a predefined, compact trajectory library, enabling the planner to proactively avoid dead ends while maintaining navigational smoothness. Notably, our approach transfers across real-world scenarios without manual annotation or fine-tuning on real-world data. The system achieves high-frequency replanning at 50 Hz onboard. Extensive simulation benchmarks demonstrate superior performance in success rate, flight time, and trajectory length, and real-world experiments further validate its effectiveness in complex scenarios.

</details>


### [495] [Throwing a Tight Spiral American Football by a Humanoid Robot](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16642)
*Zaid Mahboob,Bowen Weng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种由人形机器人实现美式橄榄球自旋稳定螺旋投掷的全身控制框架。该方法将上半身运动分为投掷阶段（轨迹优化加速球体至目标状态）和随挥阶段（模型预测控制主动控制手腕及接触手指），同时下半身执行信息化的姿势稳定。系统在29-DoF Unitree G1人形机器人上验证，实现了93.6%的自旋效率和0.286弧度的鼻部对齐误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人投掷物体研究大多集中于利用开爪范式生成动力学可行的释放速度，但对分离时刻自旋注入的显式控制研究不足，尤其针对美式橄榄球这类空气动力学各向异性物体。精确的耦合线动量与角动量是决定飞行稳定性和瞄准精度的关键，需要解决高自由度快速运动（约0.5秒内完成）以及亚100毫秒释放阶段复杂的瞬态接触动力学问题。

Method: 提出耦合的全身控制策略：下半身执行信息化的姿势稳定；上半身分为两个阶段——(1) 投掷阶段通过轨迹优化与跟踪将橄榄球加速到目标状态；(2) 随挥阶段利用模型预测控制主动控制手腕和仍处于接触中的手指，从而管理释放阶段部分欠驱动的复杂接触动力学。

Result: 在29-DoF Unitree G1人形机器人（配备7-DoF Dex3-1三指夹爪）上验证。投掷的美式橄榄球实现了高达93.6%的自旋效率、0.286弧度的线性速度-鼻部对齐误差，线性速度达5.35 m/s，角速度达14.5 rad/s。

Conclusion: 实验表明所提出的全身控制框架能够在人形机器人上实现高自旋效率的紧密螺旋投掷，验证了对空气动力学各向异性物体进行显式自旋控制的可行性，为机器人精确投掷提供了新的控制范式。

Abstract: Accurate throwing of the American football requires precise regulation of release conditions, where coupled linear and angular momentum determine flight stability and targeting accuracy. While prior work on robotic object throwing has largely focused on generating dynamically feasible release velocities using open-gripper paradigms, explicit control of spin injection at detachment remains underexplored, particularly for aerodynamically anisotropic objects like the American football. In this paper, we present the spin-stabilized controlled tight spiral throw of an American football by a humanoid robot. Achieving this requires (i) accurately reaching the desired coupled momentum, which often involves high degrees-of-freedom (DoF) movements completed within approximately half a second, and (ii) managing the complex transient contact dynamics that arise during the sub-100-millisecond release phase, when the football is effectively underactuated as it moves partially across the fingers. To this end, we develop a coupled whole-body control strategy where the lower body is performing informed stabilization while the upper body is further divided into two phases with (i) a throw phase accelerating the football to a target state through trajectory optimization and tracking, and (ii) a follow-through phase utilizing model predictive control to actively control the wrist and remaining in-contact fingers. The proposed framework is empirically validated on a 29-DoF Unitree G1 humanoid equipped with a 7-DoF Dex3-1 three-fingered gripper. The thrown American football reaches up to 93.6% spin efficiency and a 0.286 radians linear-velocity-to-nose-alignment (nose-angle) error (where an ``ideal'' tight spiral corresponds to 100 % spin efficiency and 0 radians nose-angle error) at up to a 5.35 m/s linear velocity and an angular velocity of 14.5 rad/s.

</details>


### [496] [Orbit-Planner: Towards Latent World Models for On-Orbit Obstacle Avoidance of Satellite Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16651)
*Zhijian Li,Chao Ren,Peijin Wang,Xian Sun*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出Orbit-Planner，一种两阶段潜在世界模型，用于在轨航天器避障导航。该模型学习行动条件下的航天器动力学，在潜空间进行未来状态展开，并通过物理探针从想象轨迹中解码物理状态变化。在Isaac Sim闭环节点避障导航中成功率达91.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统规划器依赖预定义地图和固定环境假设，难以适应动态在轨场景中有限观测下的碰撞风险预测需求，缺乏自适应能力。因此需要一种能从有限机载观测中预测碰撞风险、适应动态环境的规划方法。

Method: 提出两阶段潜在世界模型Orbit-Planner：(1) 学习行动条件下的航天器动力学，在潜空间进行长期未来状态展开；(2) 引入Physics Probe（物理探针）模块，用于从想象的潜轨迹中解码物理状态变化，实现物理状态恢复与碰撞风险评估。

Result: Orbit-Planner能够执行长期潜空间展开并从想象轨迹中恢复物理状态；在Isaac Sim仿真环境的闭环避障导航任务中达到91.7%的成功率。

Conclusion: Orbit-Planner通过潜在世界模型有效解决了在轨避障中依赖预定义地图的局限性，验证了潜空间规划在动态空间任务中的可行性与有效性。

Abstract: Satellite agents for on-orbit navigation tasks need to predict collision risks using limited onboard observations. However, conventional planners often rely on predefined maps and fixed environmental assumptions, limiting their adaptability in dynamic on-orbit scenarios. In this paper, we propose Orbit-Planner, a two-stage latent world model for on-orbit obstacle avoidance. Orbit-Planner learns action-conditioned spacecraft dynamics to perform future-state rollouts in latent space, and introduces a Physics Probe to decode physical state changes from imagined latent trajectories. Experiments demonstrate that Orbit-Planner can perform long-horizon latent rollouts and recover physical states from imagined trajectories. In closed-loop obstacle-avoidance navigation in Isaac Sim, it attains a success rate of 91.7%. Code is available at https://github.com/ZhijianLi2003/Orbit_Planner.

</details>


### [497] [H-PAC Hand: Control-Oriented Modeling and Tendon-Elasticity Compensation for an Underactuated Robotic Hand](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16712)
*Teng Yan,Jiongxu Chen,Teng Wang,Yue Yu,Qixiang Hua,Zihang Wang,Yongru Chen,Bingzhuo Zhong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出H-PAC，一个模块化的6驱动器、15自由度欠驱动腱驱动机械手，并建立控制导向的建模与实现框架。通过稀疏解析驱动-关节模型和基于力学的弹性补偿模型，将九关节角度预测平均绝对误差降至0.23度以下（DIP关节从1.15度降至0.18度），无需外部关节/力传感即可提升欠驱动末端执行器的姿态可重复性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 欠驱动腱驱动手虽然具有紧凑驱动和被动柔顺的优点，但肌腱在恢复弹簧载荷下会发生伸长，导致配置依赖的关节偏差，影响姿态控制的准确性和可重复性。现有方法缺乏一个控制导向的、可实际部署的建模与补偿框架。

Method: 1) 从腱布线几何推导稀疏解析驱动-关节模型；2) 建立基于力学的补偿模型，校正肌腱弹性引起的关节误差；3) 采用分层架构实现：主机负责工作空间约束的姿态映射与补偿，ESP32微控制器发出同步命令驱动六个位置控制伺服；4) 所有任务使用统一控制参数和执行策略，无需任务级重新调参。

Result: 单调伺服扫描实验显示补偿显著提升关节角预测精度：食指DIP关节MAE从1.15度降至0.18度，全部九个评估关节MAE均低于0.23度。代表性姿态和抓取配置均通过同一控制流程执行，无需控制回路中的外部关节或力传感。

Conclusion: 该工作证明了在紧凑欠驱动机器人末端执行器中，通过控制导向建模与分层实现框架，可以在不依赖外部传感的前提下有效提升姿态可重复性，为欠驱动手的实际应用提供了一个实用且低成本的解决方案。

Abstract: Underactuated tendon-driven hands offer compact actuation and passive compliance, but tendon elongation under restoring-spring loading introduces configuration-dependent joint deviations. This paper presents H-PAC, a modular 6-actuator, 15-DoF robotic hand with a control-oriented modeling and implementation framework. A sparse analytical actuator-joint model is derived from the tendon-routing geometry, and a mechanics-based compensation model is developed to account for tendon-elasticity-induced joint errors.
  The proposed method is implemented in a hierarchical architecture: a host computer performs workspace-constrained posture mapping and compensation, while an ESP32 generates synchronized commands for six position-controlled servos. The same control parameters and execution strategy are used across all tasks without task-specific retuning.
  Monotonic servo-sweep experiments show that the compensation substantially improves joint-angle prediction. The MAE of the index DIP joint decreases from 1.15 degrees to 0.18 degrees, and all nine evaluated joints achieve an MAE below 0.23 degrees. Representative postures and grasping configurations are further executed using the same control pipeline without external joint or force sensing in the control loop. The results demonstrate a practical approach to improving posture reproducibility in compact underactuated robotic end-effectors.

</details>


### [498] [MatchingPolicy: Correspondence-Aware Policy Enables Cross-Object In-Context Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16715)
*Qijin She,Hanyang Yu,Zeming Li,Ping Tan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出MatchingPolicy，一种基于稠密语义对应关系的上下文模仿学习框架，通过将示范-场景匹配与策略学习显式解耦，实现跨未见物体和语义类别的鲁棒少样本策略泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有上下文模仿学习方法在少样本策略泛化上表现有限，尤其在面对未见物体和新场景时性能下降明显。根本原因在于对应关系识别与动作适应之间存在内在冲突。

Method: 提出对应感知的扩散策略（correspondence-aware diffusion policy），将机器人动作直接条件于稠密语义对应关系上；结合视觉基础模型与新颖的两阶段匹配算法，动态建立可靠的示范-场景对应关系。

Result: 在RLBench仿真基准和真实世界操作任务上，MatchingPolicy在少样本场景下取得优越性能，并能可靠泛化到未见物体实例和语义类别。

Conclusion: 通过架构层面的显式解耦，MatchingPolicy有效解决了对应识别与动作适应之间的冲突，为上下文模仿学习提供了更强的跨分布泛化能力。

Abstract: In-context imitation learning enables few-shot policy generalization but struggles to maintain performance on unseen objects and novel scenarios. To address this, we introduce MatchingPolicy, a correspondence-driven framework that explicitly decouples demonstration-to-scene matching from policy learning. Central to our method is a correspondence-aware diffusion policy that conditions robotic actions directly on dense semantic correspondences. This architectural separation resolves the inherent conflict between correspondence identification and action adaptation, enabling robust out-of-distribution transfer. Our framework integrates vision foundation models with a novel two-stage matching algorithm to dynamically establish reliable correspondences. Extensive evaluations on RLBench and real-world manipulation tasks confirm that MatchingPolicy achieves superior few-shot performance, generalizing reliably across unseen object instances and semantic categories.

</details>


### [499] [Design Optimization for Large High-Force Soft Robot Manipulators Under Gravitational Loads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16728)
*Isara Cholaseuk,Penelope Llibre,Alexa Kyriacou,Audrey Wang,Akua K. Dickson,Ran Jing,Juan C. Pacheco Garcia,Andrew P. Sabelhaus*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种优化大型软体机器人肢体几何形状的方法，在抗屈曲约束下最大化其阻塞力，并提供闭式解。实验验证了该方法能正确预测哪些设计满足约束以及哪种设计产生最大的末端执行器力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型软体机器人领域缺乏系统化框架来确定某种设计范式是否适用于特定任务。以往的研究仅停留在概念验证原型阶段，无法在设计前预先判断软体机械臂在物理人机交互的大型尺度下是否合适。

Method: 提出一种优化软体机器人肢体几何形状的方法，在自重载荷下以抗屈曲为约束，最大化阻塞力（blocking force）。在特定假设下，该优化问题存在显式（闭式）解。

Result: 用三种几何形状的大型软体气动机械臂进行实验，结果表明该方法能正确预测哪些设计满足约束条件，以及哪种设计能产生最大的末端执行器力。

Conclusion: 该方法具有闭式解，使设计者能够事先确定某类软体机械臂在大尺度物理交互场景中是否适用，填补了大型软体机器人系统化设计框架的空白。

Abstract: Designing large soft robots capable of generating high forces for physical human-robot interaction remains a significant challenge in soft robotics. Prior work in large soft robots has focused on proof-of-concept prototypes, and no systematic framework exists for determining the suitability of a design paradigm for a desired task. This manuscript introduces a method for optimizing the geometry of a soft robot limb, maximizing its blocking force subject to an anti-bucking constraint under its own gravitational loading. We demonstrate that an explicit solution exists to the proposed optimization problem under certain assumptions. Experiments with three geometries of a large, soft, pneumatically-actuated manipulator demonstrate that the method correctly predicts which designs meet constraints and which produces the largest end-effector forces. This method, with its closed-form solution, can allow designers to determine a-priori if an intended class of soft manipulators is an appropriate choice for physical interaction at large size scales.

</details>


### [500] [Semantic- and Density-Aware Planning for Accessibility-Preserving Multi-Object Placement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16741)
*Benno Wingender,Nils Dengler,Nicolas Busch,Sicong Pan,Maren Bennewitz*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出语义-密集摆放规划（SDPP）方法，解决在线多物体货架摆放问题。该方法通过语义密度评分（结合物体间语义相似性与空间邻近度）对候选姿态排序，并使用可达性地图（AM）过滤难以到达的候选位置，同时惩罚减少可达工作空间的摆放。实验表明SDPP在语义摆放质量和货架密度上优于现有基线，AM显著减少可行性摆放姿态的识别时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 家庭服务机器人在部分占用的货架上摆放物品时，需要同时考虑语义组织、空间利用率的最大化以及未来摆放的可达性。现有方法未能联合解决这三方面问题，特别是在未来物体到达未知的在线场景下。

Method: 提出SDPP方法：1) 使用语义密度评分（结合物体间语义相似性与空间邻近度）对候选摆放姿态进行排序；2) 构建可达性地图（AM），在运动规划前过滤不可能到达的候选位置，并对减少剩余可达工作空间的摆放进行惩罚。

Result: 仿真实验表明SDPP在语义摆放质量上显著优于最先进的基线方法，并取得最高的平均货架密度；AM大幅减少了识别可行摆放姿态所需的时间。真实世界实验验证了该流程在家庭货架存储场景中的适用性。

Conclusion: SDPP有效解决了在线多物体货架摆放中语义组织、空间密集利用和机械臂可达性的联合优化问题，为长期操作规划中的货架整理任务提供了实用且可靠的解决方案。

Abstract: Long-term manipulation planning requires robots to reason not only about immediate task success but also about how current decisions affect future interactions with the environment. In this context, household service robots may need to organize groceries in partially occupied shelves while using limited storage space efficiently and preserving access for subsequent placements. In this paper, we consider an online multi-object shelf-placement setting in which future objects arrivals are unknown. Existing approaches do not jointly address semantic organization, dense space utilization, and manipulator accessibility during sequential shelf filling. To address this gap, we propose Semantic-Dense Placement Planning (SDPP), an accessibility-preserving approach that ranks candidate poses using a semantic-density score combining inter-object semantic similarity with spatial proximity. An Accessibility Map (AM) further filters candidates unlikely to be reachable before motion planning and penalizes placements that reduce the remaining accessible workspace. Simulation experiments show that SDPP significantly improves semantic placement quality over state-of-the-art baselines and achieves the highest average shelf density, while the AM substantially reduces the time required to identify feasible placement poses. A qualitative real-world experiment demonstrates the applicability of our pipeline in a domestic shelf-storage scenario.

</details>


### [501] [Neurosymbolic Embodied Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16794)
*Mohammad Albinhassan,Yuming Feng,Alessandra Russo,Pranava Madhyastha*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出一个神经符号智能体，将长周期家庭任务分解为任务导向的视觉探索和受限符号规划两个阶段。第一阶段使用视觉-语言模型和探索机制获取目标相关的谓词和实例绑定，生成符号初始状态；第二阶段通过PDDL转移模型限制解码过程，仅允许生成可执行的行动，并利用蒙特卡洛树搜索评估可执行延续。在VirtualHome和ALFWorld环境中，4B-27B开源模型成功率超过90%，最小智能体也大幅超越27B直接视觉策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言和视觉-语言模型生成的具身规划虽然看似合理但不保证可执行性，其输出可能违反环境动力学或作用于错误绑定的实体，因此需要确保规划在真实环境中可执行的机制。

Method: 采用两阶段神经符号架构：第一阶段用视觉-语言模型搭配探索工具获取目标相关谓词和实例绑定，从第一人称观察和接地交互构建符号初始状态；第二阶段用PDDL转移模型约束解码，仅允许生成可应用的行动token，并通过蒙特卡洛树搜索结合领域无关的规划启发式评估可执行延续。

Result: 在VirtualHome和ALFWorld上，4B-27B开源模型在两个环境中均超过90%成功率；最小智能体大幅超越27B直接视觉策略。约束与搜索互补：ALFWorld中单独使用任一种只能解决不到三分之一的任侍，组合后解决率超过95%。该方法生成的token远少于扩展思考模式，使用的模型可见图像也远少于直接交互。

Conclusion: 约束解码与规划搜索具有互补性，二者结合能显著提升规划的可执行性；剩余失败主要源自状态获取阶段而非规划生成阶段，且无需专门训练即可实现这些改进。

Abstract: Language and vision-language models generate plausible embodied plans but do not guarantee executability, as their outputs can violate environment dynamics or act on incorrectly grounded entities. We present a neurosymbolic agent that factors long-horizon household tasks into task-directed visual exploration and constrained symbolic planning. In the first phase, a vision-language model and exploration harness acquire goal-relevant predicates and instance bindings from egocentric observations and grounded interactions, producing a symbolic initial state. In the second, a PDDL transition model restricts decoding to tokens that extend applicable actions. Monte Carlo tree search then evaluates executable continuations using a domain-independent planning heuristic. The resulting plans are executable by construction under the transition model, with transfer to the environment conditioned on correct visual grounding. On VirtualHome and ALFWorld, open 4B-27B models exceed 90% success in both environments, and our smallest agent substantially outperforms a 27B direct visual policy in each. Constraints and search prove complementary rather than interchangeable: in ALFWorld either alone solves under a third of tasks, whereas their combination solves over 95%. The method also uses several times fewer generated tokens than extended thinking and far fewer model-visible images than direct interaction, and residual failures localize to state acquisition rather than plan generation without any specialized training.

</details>


### [502] [When State Becomes an Attack Surface: State-Semantic Injection in LLM-Driven Embodied Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16806)
*Jiawei Liu,Jiacheng Guo,Tian Zhang,Yiwei Xu,Juan Wang,Jinlin Fan,Bowen Xiao,Chi Guo,Keyan Guo,Hongxin Hu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文综述了大语言模型（LLMs）从文本生成模型向具身智能体核心的演进过程，涵盖其在任务理解、高层规划、行为决策中的作用，并介绍了SayCan、Code as Policies、ProgPrompt、VoxPoser、PaLM-E、RT-2和GR00T N1等代表性工作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统LLM智能体通过网页、文档、数据库或外部工具获取信息并生成调用序列，当与机器人系统整合时，需要探索LLM如何承担任务理解、高层规划和行为决策等功能，推动智能体从纯文本生成向具身智能方向发展。

Method: 文章梳理了LLM驱动的具身智能体技术路线：1）SayCan结合语言模型的任务推理能力与机器人技能的可供性；2）Code as Policies和ProgPrompt分别通过策略代码和程序化提示生成机器人任务计划；3）VoxPoser利用语言模型和视觉-语言模型构建三维价值图指导机器人操作；4）PaLM-E、RT-2、GR00T N1等视觉-语言-动作模型强化语言、视觉感知与机器人动作之间的联系。

Result: LLM驱动的具身智能体需要理解用户指令，并结合场景状态、物体属性、空间关系和执行反馈完成任务接地（task grounding），然后将生成的行动计划交给技能库、运动规划器或控制器执行。

Conclusion: 大语言模型已成为具身智能体的核心组件，能够实现从任务理解到行为决策的完整链条，但其成功执行依赖于与场景感知、任务接地和底层执行模块的紧密协作。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated capabilities in in-context learning, task decomposition, step-by-step reasoning, and code generation, driving their gradual evolution from text generation models into the core of agents capable of perceiving environments, invoking tools, and executing tasks. Traditional LLM Agents typically obtain information through webpages, documents, databases, or external tools and generate corresponding invocation sequences according to user goals; when this technology is further integrated with robotic systems, large language models begin to undertake functions such as task understanding, high-level planning, and behavioral decision-making. SayCan combines the task reasoning capability of language models with the affordances of robotic skills, while Code as Policies and ProgPrompt generate robot task plans through policy code and programmatic prompting, respectively, and VoxPoser uses language models and vision-language models to construct three-dimensional value maps to guide robotic manipulation \cite{6,7,8,9}. Vision-language-action models such as PaLM-E, RT-2, and GR00T N1 further strengthen the connection among language, visual perception, and robotic actions \cite{10,11,12}. In such LLM-driven embodied agents, the model not only needs to understand user instructions, but also needs to combine scene states, object attributes, spatial relations, and execution feedback to complete task grounding, and then hand the generated action plan to skill libraries, motion planners, or controllers for execution.

</details>


### [503] [Adaptive Repulsive Pheromone Clustering for Foraging Robot Swarms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16822)
*Carlos Pena-Caballero,Constantine Tarawneh,Qi Lu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出自适应排斥信息素聚类(ARPC)方法，通过让机器人在巢穴附近沉积标记已探索区域的排斥信息素路径点，并聚类估计低价值搜索区域，将机器人重新导向未探索区域，从而解决CPFA在资源稀缺时重复探索、效率低下的问题。在ARGoS模拟中验证了该方法在多种环境下的性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CPFA虽能实现去中心化资源收集，但常重复访问已探索区域而忽略其他区域，尤其在资源变得稀缺时效率显著下降。现有CPFA及其变体(GPFA)在后期收集阶段性能退化，需要一种既能利用已知资源又能系统避免冗余探索的改进方法。

Method: ARPC结合三种机制：1) 机器人在探索位置沉积排斥信息素路径点标记已探索区域；2) 将排斥路径点聚类在巢穴附近以估计低价值搜索区域；3) 利用已知资源的开发与避免冗余探索的系统性回避相结合，将机器人重定向至可能未访问的区域。

Result: 在ARGoS仿真中，针对不同场地大小、资源密度以及聚集型、随机型和幂律空间分布进行广泛测试，ARPC一致优于CPFA和GPFA。早期发现阶段提升10%，后期收集阶段提升高达60%，而传统方法在此阶段性能显著退化。

Conclusion: ARPC提供了一种可扩展且稳健的群体觅食策略，适用于大规模异构群体环境，有效平衡了资源开发与探索多样性，显著提升资源发现和收集效率。

Abstract: The Central Place Foraging Algorithm (CPFA) combines site fidelity, pheromone-guided navigation, and uninformed random search to enable decentralized resource collection in robot swarms. However, CPFA often revisits previously explored regions while leaving other areas insufficiently searched, reducing efficiency as resources become scarce. In this paper, we propose Adaptive Repulsive Pheromone Clustering (ARPC), a bio-inspired method in which robots deposit repulsive pheromone waypoints to mark previously explored locations. These waypoints are clustered around the nest to estimate low-value search regions, allowing robots to be redirected toward likely unvisited areas. By integrating the exploitation of known resources with systematic avoidance of redundant exploration, ARPC improves search diversity and resource discovery efficiency. Extensive simulations in ARGoS across varying arena sizes, resource densities, and clustered, random, and power-law spatial distributions demonstrate that ARPC consistently outperforms CPFA and the Grid-Based CPFA (GPFA). In particular, ARPC yields significant gains during both early discovery (10\%) and late-stage (up to 60\%) collection, where conventional methods typically degrade. These results indicate that ARPC provides a scalable and robust strategy for large-scale heterogeneous swarm foraging environments.

</details>


### [504] [HAF: Adapting Generalist VLAs to Humanoid Whole-Body Loco-manipulation via Hierarchical Action Flow and Spectral Latent RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16837)
*Langzhe Gu,Chengkai Hou,Meng Li,Xinhua Wang,Jiaming Liu,Xinyuan Lv,Bowei Zhang,Shuanghao Bai,Guangrun Li,Jingyang He,Gaole Dai,Ziluo Ding,Zhiyuan Xu,Kuan Cheng,Jian Tang,Zhengping Che,Shanghang Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出HAF框架，将通用VLA基础模型迁移到人形机器人全身移动操作任务。HAF由HAF-VLA（分层动作流生成器）和HAF-Steer（潜在离线到在线强化学习管线）两部分组成，在7个真实世界任务中超越了单阶段VLA基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用VLA基础模型难以直接应用于人形机器人全身移动操作：高维度和强耦合的人形运动使得传统单阶段VLA架构难以协调行走、腰姿和双臂操作；离线行为克隆训练的模型在真实部署中表现次优；直接在线微调大型VLA骨干网络计算代价高且存在安全风险。

Method: HAF由两部分组成：1) HAF-VLA：基于预训练流匹配VLA的分层动作流生成器，将全身动作去噪分为三个顺序阶段，使用阶段嵌入和跨阶段KV缓存保留运动学依赖；2) HAF-Steer：基于冻结HAF-VLA的潜在离线到在线RL管线，利用流匹配可逆性和DCT降维将RL优化限制在紧凑噪声子空间，训练正则化SAC策略，避免更新大型VLA骨干。

Result: 在7个真实世界人形移动操作任务上，HAF超越了普通单阶段VLA基线，改善了全身协调性和任务性能。

Conclusion: HAF验证了通过分层动作生成和潜在子空间RL微调，可以将通用VLA基础模型有效迁移到人形全身移动操作任务，无需更新大规模VLA骨干网络。

Abstract: Humanoid robots hold great promise as general-purpose agents in human-centered environments, yet generalist vision-language-action (VLA) foundation models are not readily applicable to humanoid whole-body loco-manipulation. The high dimensionality and interdependence of humanoid motions make it challenging for conventional single-stage VLA architectures to coordinate locomotion, waist posture, and dual-arm manipulation effectively. Moreover, policies trained through offline behavior cloning can remain suboptimal during real-world deployment. Although online reinforcement learning can refine policies through real-world interaction, directly tuning large VLA backbones demands excessive computation and may introduce safety risks during real-robot exploration. To address these bottlenecks, we introduce HAF (Humanoid Adaptation Framework), a two-part framework consisting of HAF-VLA and HAF-Steer that transfers off-the-shelf generalist VLA foundation models to humanoid whole-body loco-manipulation. HAF-VLA is a hierarchical action-flow generator built on a pretrained flow-matching VLA. It splits full-body action denoising into three sequential stages with stage embeddings and cross-stage KV caches that retain kinematic dependencies, avoiding incoherent whole-body actions from one-shot generation. On top of the frozen HAF-VLA, HAF-Steer is a latent offline-to-online RL pipeline that leverages flow-matching invertibility and DCT-based dimensionality reduction to restrict RL optimization to a compact noise subspace and train a regularized SAC policy. This avoids updating the large VLA backbone and enables efficient real-world policy refinement. Evaluated on seven real-world humanoid loco-manipulation tasks, HAF surpasses vanilla single-stage VLA baselines and improves whole-body coordination and task performance. Project website: https://grange007.github.io/HAF .

</details>


### [505] [Security of Foundation-Model-Powered Embodied Agents: Attack Surfaces, Attacks, Defenses, and Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16843)
*Jiawei Liu,Jiacheng Guo,Tian Zhang,Yiwei Xu,Juan Wang,Jinlin Fan,Bowen Xiao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种以信任边界为中心（trust-boundary-centric）的视角来审视基于基础模型的具身代理安全，将系统划分为五层十二个攻击面，基于58条攻击记录和61条防御记录进行量化分析，揭示攻击研究集中于多模态感知和动作接口，而防御集中于动作级和运行时保护，并指出上下文记忆、中间件、世界状态完整性和多智能体信任等未充分探索的领域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的安全综述通常按机制（如越狱、提示注入、后门、投毒、对抗样本）来组织威胁，但这些分类无法一致地识别攻击者首次进入具身控制回路的入口点。需要一种能区分攻击面与攻击机制的新分类框架。

Method: 采用"首个被攻破信任边界"原则，将攻击面与攻击机制分离，把系统组织为五个层次和十二个攻击面，涵盖模型供应链、用户指令、上下文与记忆、物理语义环境、多模态感知、世界状态、内部推理、任务规划、动作接口、中间件、多智能体通信和执行控制。基于截至2026年8月15日收集的58条攻击记录和61条防御记录进行定量分析。

Result: 量化分析显示：攻击研究集中在多模态感知和动作接口，防御研究集中在动作级和运行时保护；上下文与长期记忆、中间件与网络、世界状态完整性、多智能体信任仍相对未充分探索。分析了代表性攻击、跨层传播、防御部署位置和评估实践。

Conclusion: 总结出开放挑战：状态溯源（state provenance）、组合防御、长时程攻击传播、物理可实现性、拜占庭多机器人行为以及统一的闭环评估。

Abstract: Foundation models are increasingly used for perception, reasoning, planning, and action generation in embodied agents, creating security risks that can propagate from digital inputs to physical behavior. Existing surveys often organize threats by mechanisms such as jailbreaks, prompt injection, backdoors, poisoning, or adversarial examples, but these categories do not consistently identify where an adversary first enters the embodied control loop. We present a trust-boundary-centric survey of foundation-model-powered embodied-agent security. Using a first-compromised-trust-boundary principle, we separate attack surface from attack mechanism and organize the system into five layers and twelve attack surfaces spanning the model supply chain, user instructions, context and memory, physical semantic environments, multimodal perception, world state, internal reasoning, task planning, action interfaces, middleware, multi-agent communication, and execution control. Based on 58 attack records and 61 defense records collected through August 15, 2026, we analyze representative attacks, cross-layer propagation, defense placement, and evaluation practices. Our quantitative analysis shows that attack research is concentrated on multimodal perception and action interfaces, while defenses are especially concentrated on action-level and runtime protection. Context and long-term memory, middleware and networking, world-state integrity, and multi-agent trust remain comparatively underexplored. We conclude with open challenges in state provenance, compositional defenses, long-horizon attack propagation, physical realizability, Byzantine multi-robot behavior, and unified closed-loop evaluation.

</details>


### [506] [FlexWorm: Primitive-augmented Hybrid Contact-motion Planning for Suction-based Multi-segment Deformable Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16853)
*Zili Tang,Tiecheng Guo,Qinyue Zhang,Meng Guo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向多段吸附式软体机器人的规划框架，该框架同时处理离散吸附切换和连续身体变形，通过分块IK混合搜索（IKHS）和基元增强混合搜索（PaHS）实现3D复杂表面上的高效导航，在仿真和硬件实验中均验证了其有效性和鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有软体机器人规划方法严重依赖人工设计的步态和环境特定的运动脚本，缺乏通用性。多段吸附式软体机器人虽然适合受限或脆弱环境中的检测维护任务，但如何自动规划其在复杂三维表面上的完整导航仍然是一个未解决的关键挑战。

Method: 框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 分块IK混合搜索（IKHS）：在可行的吸附切换上进行最佳优先搜索，仅对诱导的自由块求解逆运动学，处理离散吸附与连续形变的耦合问题；(2) 基元增强混合搜索（PaHS）：利用学习得到的观测-基元嵌入检索已验证的短运动片段以快速生成本地提议，检索失败时回退到标准IKHS分支。

Result: 仿真中，框架在规划成功率、过渡质量和效率方面一致优于对照基线；PaHS在保持与IKHS相同成功率的同时显著减少规划时间。在气动多段软体机器人上的重复硬件实验验证了框架的可执行性以及面对驱动和吸附不确定性时的在线恢复能力。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了一种与具体驱动实现无关的通用规划框架，有效解决了软体机器人在复杂表面上自主导航的规划难题，兼具规划质量与计算效率，并在真实硬件上验证了实用性。

Abstract: Multi-segment suction-based soft robots are promising for inspection and maintenance in confined or fragile environments, but existing approaches still depend heavily on manually designed gaits and environment-specific motion scripts. This work presents a planning framework for serial multi-segment soft robots with deformable body segments and boundary suction pads. The formulation targets full 3D navigation on complex surfaces and explicitly handles discrete adhesion switching and continuous body deformation under geometric, collision, and quasi-static feasibility constraints, while remaining agnostic to the specific actuation realization used to produce segment deformation. Its core, block-wise IK hybrid search (IKHS), performs best-first search over feasible adhesion transitions while solving inverse kinematics only on induced free blocks. On top of IKHS, primitive-augmented hybrid search (PaHS) uses a learned observation--primitive embedding to retrieve short validated motion segments for fast local proposal, with fallback to standard IKHS branching when retrieval fails. In simulation, the framework consistently outperforms controlled baselines in planning success, transition quality, and efficiency across diverse terrains. PaHS matches IKHS in success rate while substantially reducing planning time. Repeated hardware experiments on a pneumatic multi-segment soft robot further demonstrate executability and online recovery under actuation and adhesion uncertainty.

</details>


### [507] [$τ_0$-VLA: a Hierarchical Robot Foundation Model with World-Model-Guided Test-Time Computation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16885)
*Xiaowei Cai,Yunuo Cai,Bingao Chen,Jingxiao Chen,Zhi Chen,Siyuan Feng,Tengyu Hou,Jingshun Huang,Han Jiang,Runkun Ju,Dong Li,Mingxiang Li,Shaowei Li,Xinchen Li,Yifan Li,Yi Liu,Zhongyuan Liu,Jianlan Luo,Junwen Miao,Ruiqi Ni,Buqing Nie,Mingjie Pan,Xinlin Ren,Jianheng Song,Jiaxu Wang,Peiqi Wang,Sen Wang,Xiaoyan Wang,Dafeng Wei,Dongming Wu,Pengwei Xie,Pu Yang,Hangjian Ye,Xiangyu Yue,Jinyu Zhang,Qinglin Zhang,Xueyong Zhao,Pengfei Zhou,Yue Zhou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出τ₀-VLA，一个分层机器人基础模型，通过世界模型引导的测试时计算来解决长时程机器人操作问题。高层策略在每次推理时利用执行记忆生成子任务，并在需要时搜索替代方案，然后由低层策略执行。模型在40,115小时异构真实世界数据上训练，增加测试时计算能显著提升子任务预测精度和闭环任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的分层视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在每次决策时只通过单次前向传播，缺乏为困难或关键决策分配额外计算资源的机制，限制了长时程任务中的推理能力。

Method: 提出τ₀-VLA框架：(1) 高层策略将子任务生成建模为可扩展计算量的推理问题；(2) 通过世界模型引导的测试时计算，在必要时搜索替代子任务方案；(3) 利用执行记忆辅助决策；(4) 低层策略跨多机器人本体执行子任务；(5) 在40,115小时异构真实世界数据上进行多模态协同训练。

Result: 在域内和分布偏移场景下，增加测试时计算显著提高了下一代子任务预测精度，并将这些改进转化为长时程机器人操作任务中更高的闭环成功率。

Conclusion: 通过为高层子任务生成引入计算可扩展的测试时搜索机制，τ₀-VLA展示了在长时程机器人操作中有效分配计算资源的价值，为层次化VLA模型在复杂、长时程任务中的推理能力提供了新的方向。

Abstract: Long-horizon robot manipulation requires a robot to both execute individual skills reliably and sequence them coherently over extended tasks. Most hierarchical vision-language-action (VLA) models make each such decision with a single forward pass, leaving no mechanism to allocate additional computation to difficult or consequential choices. We introduce $τ_0$-VLA, a hierarchical robot foundation model that formulates high-level subtask generation as a compute-scalable inference problem through world-model-guided test-time computation. At each inference step, the high-level policy uses execution memory to generate a subtask and, when needed, searches over alternatives before committing to its output. A low-level policy then executes the generated subtask across multiple robot embodiments. The policy is trained on 40,115 hours of heterogeneous real-world data with multimodal co-training. Across in-domain and distribution-shifted settings, allocating additional test-time computation substantially improves next-subtask prediction accuracy, and these gains translate into higher closed-loop success on long-horizon robot manipulation tasks.

</details>


### [508] [Don't Drop the BATON: Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation via Agentic Subtask Exploration and Transition-aware Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16889)
*Bingxin Xu,Yuzhang Shang,Emilio Ferrara*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: BATON提出了一种针对长时程机器人操作任务的框架，通过将子任务作为探索单元、引入过渡感知记忆（包含调用过渡、交接过渡和前瞻过渡），在无需更新参数的情况下，将探索成本从指数级降至线性级，并在RoboMemArena基准上显著超越了现有最优方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程机器人操作需要串联多个接触丰富的技能，但现有VLA模型链式执行时会因错误累积而失败。现有的"冻结VLA+LLM代理"方案在长时程任务中面临两大问题：(1) 探索成本随阶段数呈指数级增长（T^K），且失败无法归因到具体阶段；(2) 缺乏过渡表示，VLA原语只有退出条件而无进入条件，导致子任务成功形式无法被后继任务利用。

Method: BATON采用两个核心策略：(1) 以子任务为探索单元，在廉价的短时程机制中探索每个子任务并存储解决方案，然后组合成长时程轨迹，使探索成本变为加性（T*K）且失败可归因到单一阶段；(2) 引入过渡感知记忆，包括：子任务内的验证器代理管理调用过渡（仅在腕部视图确认场景就绪后才调用VLA）；子任务间的交接过渡恢复被前任残差扰乱的进入状态；前瞻过渡选择其结果可被后继继承的策略。全程不更新参数。

Result: 在长时程基准RoboMemArena上，BATON相比现有最优方法将任务成功率提升了11.6%，累计成功率提升了14.9%。

Conclusion: BATON通过将探索单元粒度细化到子任务层面并引入过渡感知记忆机制，有效解决了长时程机器人操作中错误累积和子任务间状态不兼容的问题，证明了无需参数更新即可显著提升长时程任务性能的可行性。

Abstract: Long-horizon robot manipulation chains many contact-rich skills into one multi-stage task. Vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly master the individual skills, yet the chain still fails: errors compound beyond the policy's ability to correct, and one subtask silently constrains the next. A promising recipe freezes the VLA and puts an LLM agent in charge: it plans in language, moves in free space with analytic primitives, invokes the VLA only for contact-rich segments, and writes adaptation into language memory. Applied to long horizons, it breaks twice. (1) Competence comes from whole-task exploration at test time, whose cost is multiplicative in stages: if one stage needs T episodes, a K-stage task needs about T^K, and a failure does not reveal which stage caused it. (2) It has no representation of transitions: the VLA primitive carries an exit but no entry condition, so a subtask can succeed in a form its successor cannot use. We present BATON. Against (1), BATON makes the subtask the unit of exploration: each is explored in the cheap short-horizon regime and its solution stored in memory; a long-horizon trajectory is then composed from these solutions rather than discovered whole. Cost becomes additive (T*K) and every failure is attributed to a single stage. Against (2), BATON equips exploration with a transition-aware memory. Within a subtask, a verifier agent governs the invocation transition: the VLA is called only after the wrist view confirms the scene is ready. Across subtasks, a handoff transition restores an entry state disturbed by the predecessor's residue, and a lookahead transition selects the strategy whose outcome the successor can inherit. No parameters are updated. On the long-horizon benchmark RoboMemArena, BATON improves task success by 11.6% and cumulative success by 14.9% over the SoTA.

</details>
